// === PROCEDURAL TACTICAL AUDIO ENGINE (WEB AUDIO API) ===
const TacticalAudio = (() => {
    let audioCtx = null;
    let masterGain = null;
    let enabled = true;
    let volume = 0.45;

    function init() {
        if (!audioCtx) {
            const Ctx = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
            if (Ctx) {
                audioCtx = new Ctx();
                masterGain = audioCtx.createGain();
                masterGain.gain.value = volume;
                masterGain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
            }
        }
        if (audioCtx && audioCtx.state === 'suspended') {
            audioCtx.resume();
        }
    }

    function setVolume(v) {
        volume = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, v));
        if (masterGain && audioCtx) masterGain.gain.setValueAtTime(volume, audioCtx.currentTime);
    }

    function noiseBuffer(duration) {
        const sr = audioCtx.sampleRate;
        const len = Math.floor(sr * duration);
        const buf = audioCtx.createBuffer(1, len, sr);
        const data = buf.getChannelData(0);
        for (let i = 0; i < len; i++) data[i] = Math.random() * 2 - 1;
        return buf;
    }

    function playGunshot(weaponId) {
        if (!enabled) return;
        init();
        if (!audioCtx) return;
        const t = audioCtx.currentTime;

        const profiles = {
            m4a1:    { dur: 0.16, freq: 1100, q: 1.1, punch: 150, gain: 0.55 },
            mp5:     { dur: 0.11, freq: 1450, q: 1.5, punch: 190, gain: 0.42 },
            ak47:    { dur: 0.21, freq: 820,  q: 0.9, punch: 125, gain: 0.65 },
            scar:    { dur: 0.24, freq: 720,  q: 0.85, punch: 105, gain: 0.72 },
            m249:    { dur: 0.18, freq: 980,  q: 1.0, punch: 135, gain: 0.62 },
            barrett: { dur: 0.42, freq: 480,  q: 0.7, punch: 72,  gain: 0.95 }
        };
        const p = profiles[weaponId] || profiles.m4a1;

        // Supersonic crack + propellant burst
        const noise = audioCtx.createBufferSource();
        noise.buffer = noiseBuffer(p.dur);
        const filter = audioCtx.createBiquadFilter();
        filter.type = 'bandpass';
        filter.frequency.setValueAtTime(p.freq, t);
        filter.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(140, t + p.dur);
        filter.Q.value = p.q;

        const nGain = audioCtx.createGain();
        nGain.gain.setValueAtTime(p.gain, t);
        nGain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, t + p.dur);

        noise.connect(filter);
        filter.connect(nGain);
        nGain.connect(masterGain);
        noise.start(t);

        // Low-end chamber punch
        const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
        osc.type = 'triangle';
        osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(p.punch, t);
        osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(32, t + p.dur * 0.75);
        const oGain = audioCtx.createGain();
        oGain.gain.setValueAtTime(p.gain * 0.8, t);
        oGain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, t + p.dur * 0.75);
        osc.connect(oGain);
        oGain.connect(masterGain);
        osc.start(t);
        osc.stop(t + p.dur * 0.8);

        // Brass casing clink 140ms later
        setTimeout(() => {
            if (!audioCtx) return;
            const ct = audioCtx.currentTime;
            const clink = audioCtx.createOscillator();
            clink.type = 'sine';
            clink.frequency.setValueAtTime(3400 + Math.random() * 600, ct);
            const cGain = audioCtx.createGain();
            cGain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.06, ct);
            cGain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, ct + 0.045);
            clink.connect(cGain);
            cGain.connect(masterGain);
            clink.start(ct);
            clink.stop(ct + 0.05);
        }, 140 + Math.random() * 50);
    }

    function playMetallicClick(freq = 1800, dur = 0.05, vol = 0.25) {
        if (!enabled) return;
        init();
        if (!audioCtx) return;
        const t = audioCtx.currentTime;
        const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
        osc.type = 'square';
        osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, t);
        osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(freq * 0.45, t + dur);
        const g = audioCtx.createGain();
        g.gain.setValueAtTime(vol, t);
        g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, t + dur);
        osc.connect(g);
        g.connect(masterGain);
        osc.start(t);
        osc.stop(t + dur);
    }

    function playHitmarker(isCrit = false) {
        playMetallicClick(isCrit ? 2600 : 1950, 0.045, isCrit ? 0.35 : 0.22);
    }

    function playExplosion() {
        if (!enabled) return;
        init();
        if (!audioCtx) return;
        const t = audioCtx.currentTime;
        const noise = audioCtx.createBufferSource();
        noise.buffer = noiseBuffer(0.85);
        const lp = audioCtx.createBiquadFilter();
        lp.type = 'lowpass';
        lp.frequency.setValueAtTime(420, t);
        lp.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(45, t + 0.85);
        const g = audioCtx.createGain();
        g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.95, t);
        g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, t + 0.85);
        noise.connect(lp);
        lp.connect(g);
        g.connect(masterGain);
        noise.start(t);
    }

    function playSlash() {
        if (!enabled) return;
        init();
        if (!audioCtx) return;
        const t = audioCtx.currentTime;
        const noise = audioCtx.createBufferSource();
        noise.buffer = noiseBuffer(0.18);
        const bp = audioCtx.createBiquadFilter();
        bp.type = 'bandpass';
        bp.frequency.setValueAtTime(600, t);
        bp.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(2200, t + 0.09);
        bp.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(400, t + 0.18);
        const g = audioCtx.createGain();
        g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.35, t);
        g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, t + 0.18);
        noise.connect(bp);
        bp.connect(g);
        g.connect(masterGain);
        noise.start(t);
    }

    return { init, setVolume, playGunshot, playMetallicClick, playHitmarker, playExplosion, playSlash };
})();

const SHOP_ARMOR = [
    { id: 'recon', name: 'Standard BDU Uniform', rarity: 'Common', color: '#9ca3af', price: 0, maxHp: 100, reduction: 0 },
    { id: 'kevlar', name: 'Level II Soft Kevlar Vest', rarity: 'Uncommon', color: '#4ade80', price: 1500, maxHp: 120, reduction: 0.15 },
    { id: 'aegis', name: 'Level IIIA Tactical Rig', rarity: 'Rare', color: '#38bdf8', price: 4500, maxHp: 150, reduction: 0.30 },
    { id: 'valkyrie', name: 'Level IV Ceramic Plate Carrier', rarity: 'Epic', color: '#c084fc', price: 9000, maxHp: 185, reduction: 0.45 },
    { id: 'titan', name: 'EOD Heavy Bomb Suit', rarity: 'Legendary', color: '#fbbf24', price: 14500, maxHp: 230, reduction: 0.60 }
];

let credits = 1500;
let ownedWeapons = ['vx4'];
let ownedArmors = ['recon'];
let equippedWeapon = SHOP_WEAPONS[0];
let equippedArmor = SHOP_ARMOR[0];
let shopTab = 'weapons';

function updateCreditsUI() {
    document.getElementById('credits-display').innerText = '$' + credits.toLocaleString();
}

function renderShop() {
    updateCreditsUI();
    const grid = document.getElementById('shop-grid');
    grid.innerHTML = '';
    const list = shopTab === 'weapons' ? SHOP_WEAPONS : SHOP_ARMOR;
    list.forEach(item => {
        const owned = shopTab === 'weapons' ? ownedWeapons.includes(item.id) : ownedArmors.includes(item.id);
        const equipped = shopTab === 'weapons' ? equippedWeapon.id === item.id : equippedArmor.id === item.id;
        const statLine = shopTab === 'weapons'
            ? `DMG: ${item.dmg} | MAG: ${item.mag}`
            : `-${Math.round(item.reduction * 100)}% INCOMING DMG | ${item.maxHp} HP`;
        const btnLabel = equipped ? 'EQUIPPED' : (owned ? 'EQUIP' : `BUY ($${item.price.toLocaleString()})`);
        const disabled = equipped || (!owned && credits < item.price);

        const card = document.createElement('div');
        card.className = 'shop-card';
        card.style.borderColor = item.color;
        card.innerHTML = `
            <div>
                <div style="font-size:0.75rem; font-weight:bold; color:${item.color}; letter-spacing:2px; text-transform:uppercase;">${item.rarity}</div>
                <div style="font-size:1.05rem; font-weight:bold; color:#fff; margin:4px 0;">${item.name}</div>
                <div style="font-size:0.8rem; color:#aaa;">${statLine}</div>
            </div>
            <button ${disabled ? 'disabled' : ''} data-id="${item.id}">${btnLabel}</button>
        `;
        card.querySelector('button').addEventListener('click', (e) => {
            e.stopPropagation();
            if (shopTab === 'weapons') {
                if (!owned && credits >= item.price) { credits -= item.price; ownedWeapons.push(item.id); }
                if (ownedWeapons.includes(item.id)) equippedWeapon = item;
            } else {
                if (!owned && credits >= item.price) { credits -= item.price; ownedArmors.push(item.id); }
                if (ownedArmors.includes(item.id)) equippedArmor = item;
            }
            renderShop();
        });
        grid.appendChild(card);
    });
}

// Procedural Wall Texture Cache (Offscreen Canvases for crisp realistic raycast slices)
const wallTextures = {};
function buildWallTextures() {
    const texSize = 64;
    // Texture 1: Reinforced Crimson Bunker Brick
    const c1 = document.createElement('canvas'); c1.width = texSize; c1.height = texSize;
    const g1 = c1.getContext('2d');
    g1.fillStyle = '#3b1010'; g1.fillRect(0, 0, texSize, texSize);
    for (let y = 0; y < texSize; y += 8) {
        const offset = (y / 8) % 2 === 0 ? 0 : 8;
        for (let x = -8; x < texSize; x += 16) {
            const shade = 55 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 35);
            g1.fillStyle = `rgb(${shade + 35}, 14, 14)`;
            g1.fillRect(x + offset + 1, y + 1, 14, 6);
        }
    }
    // Hazard stripe at bottom
    g1.fillStyle = '#eab308'; g1.fillRect(0, 56, texSize, 8);
    g1.fillStyle = '#111';
    for (let x = -8; x < texSize; x += 12) {
        g1.beginPath(); g1.moveTo(x, 64); g1.lineTo(x + 6, 56); g1.lineTo(x + 10, 56); g1.lineTo(x + 4, 64); g1.fill();
    }
    wallTextures[1] = c1;

    // Texture 2: Tactical Steel Ribbed Bulkhead
    const c2 = document.createElement('canvas'); c2.width = texSize; c2.height = texSize;
    const g2 = c2.getContext('2d');
    g2.fillStyle = '#262930'; g2.fillRect(0, 0, texSize, texSize);
    g2.fillStyle = '#181a1f'; g2.fillRect(2, 2, texSize - 4, texSize - 4);
    for (let x = 6; x < texSize; x += 10) {
        g2.fillStyle = '#363b45'; g2.fillRect(x, 6, 4, texSize - 12);
    }
    g2.fillStyle = '#00ff41'; g2.fillRect(28, 10, 8, 3);
    wallTextures[2] = c2;

    // Texture 3: Encrypted Server Mainframe / Intel Terminal Wall
    const c3 = document.createElement('canvas'); c3.width = texSize; c3.height = texSize;
    const g3 = c3.getContext('2d');
    g3.fillStyle = '#0f172a'; g3.fillRect(0, 0, texSize, texSize);
    g3.strokeStyle = '#334155'; g3.strokeRect(3, 3, texSize - 6, texSize - 6);
    for (let y = 8; y < 56; y += 6) {
        g3.fillStyle = '#1e293b'; g3.fillRect(8, y, 48, 4);
        g3.fillStyle = Math.random() > 0.4 ? '#f59e0b' : '#38bdf8';
        g3.fillRect(10 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 36), y + 1, 4, 2);
    }
    wallTextures[3] = c3;
}
buildWallTextures();

function addKillFeed(msg, borderColor = "var(--tactical-green)") {
    const box = document.getElementById('killfeed-container');
    if (!box) return;
    const item = document.createElement('div');
    item.className = 'killfeed-item';
    item.style.borderLeftColor = borderColor;
    item.innerText = msg;
    box.prepend(item);
    while (box.children.length > 5) box.removeChild(box.lastChild);
    setTimeout(() => { if (item.parentNode) item.remove(); }, 4500);
}

function showHitmarker(isCrit = false) {
    const hm = document.getElementById('hitmarker');
    if (!hm) return;
    hm.className = isCrit ? 'crit' : '';
    hm.style.opacity = '1';
    TacticalAudio.playHitmarker(isCrit);
    setTimeout(() => { hm.style.opacity = '0'; }, 110);
}

function setADS(active) {
    if (gameState !== 'playing' || player.currentWeapon !== 'gun' || player.reloading || player.isHealing || playerRespawnTimer > 0) {
        active = false;
    }
    isADS = active;
    const scopeOverlay = document.getElementById('ads-scope-overlay');
    const reticleSvg = document.getElementById('ads-reticle-svg');
    if (isADS) {
        isSprinting = false;
        weaponWrap.classList.remove('sprinting');
        weaponWrap.classList.add('ads-active');
        if (equippedWeapon.id === 'barrett' || equippedWeapon.id === 'scar') {
            scopeOverlay.style.display = 'flex';
            crosshair.style.display = 'none';
            reticleSvg.innerHTML = equippedWeapon.id === 'barrett'
                ? `<svg viewBox="0 0 200 200" style="width:100%;height:100%;"><line x1="0" y1="100" x2="200" y2="100" stroke="#38bdf8" stroke-width="0.8"/><line x1="100" y1="0" x2="100" y2="200" stroke="#38bdf8" stroke-width="0.8"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="24" fill="none" stroke="#38bdf8" stroke-width="0.6"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="2" fill="#ff3131"/></svg>`
                : `<svg viewBox="0 0 200 200" style="width:100%;height:100%;"><polygon points="100,94 94,106 106,106" fill="none" stroke="#ff3131" stroke-width="1.4"/><line x1="100" y1="106" x2="100" y2="150" stroke="#ff3131" stroke-width="1"/></svg>`;
        } else {
            scopeOverlay.style.display = 'none';
            crosshair.style.display = 'block';
            crosshair.style.transform = 'translate(-50%, -50%) scale(0.75)';
        }
    } else {
        weaponWrap.classList.remove('ads-active');
        scopeOverlay.style.display = 'none';
        if (gameState === 'playing') {
            crosshair.style.display = 'block';
            crosshair.style.transform = 'translate(-50%, -50%) scale(1)';
        }
    }
}

function triggerKillstreak(slot) {
    const now = Date.now();
    if (slot === 'uav' && killStreakCount >= 3) {
        killStreakCount -= 3;
        uavActiveUntil = now + 20000;
        TacticalAudio.playMetallicClick(2400, 0.12, 0.35);
        showNotification("UAV RECON ONLINE (20s)", "#38bdf8");
        addKillFeed("ALLIED UAV SWEEPING SECTOR", "#38bdf8");
    } else if (slot === 'airstrike' && killStreakCount >= 6) {
        killStreakCount -= 6;
        TacticalAudio.playExplosion();
        showNotification("ORBITAL BARRAGE INBOUND!", "#fb923c");
        addKillFeed("ORBITAL ARTILLERY STRIKE DEPLOYED", "#fb923c");
        enemies.forEach((en, idx) => {
            if (!en.isDying && idx < 5) {
                processExplosion(en.x, en.y);
            }
        });
    } else if (slot === 'overdrive' && killStreakCount >= 9) {
        killStreakCount -= 9;
        overdriveActiveUntil = now + 15000;
        player.health = equippedArmor.maxHp;
        TacticalAudio.playMetallicClick(2200, 0.07, 0.38);
                player.ammo = equippedWeapon.mag;
        TacticalAudio.playMetallicClick(1600, 0.15, 0.4);
        showNotification("JUGGERNAUT OVERDRIVE ACTIVE!", "#fbbf24");
        addKillFeed("JUGGERNAUT COMBAT STIM INJECTED", "#fbbf24");
    }
    updateUI();
}


function resizeCanvas() {
    canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
    canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
    pCanvas.width = window.innerWidth;
    pCanvas.height = window.innerHeight;
    zBuffer = new Array(canvas.width);
}
window.addEventListener('resize', resizeCanvas);
resizeCanvas();

function createMenuParticle(initializeFullHeight = false) {
    const isFire = Math.random() > 0.40; 
    return {
        type: isFire ? 'fire' : 'ash',
        x: Math.random() * pCanvas.width,
        y: initializeFullHeight ? (Math.random() * pCanvas.height) : (pCanvas.height + 15),
        speed: isFire ? (1.0 + Math.random() * 1.8) : (0.4 + Math.random() * 0.9),
        size: isFire ? (2.0 + Math.random() * 4) : (2.5 + Math.random() * 5),
        maxSize: isFire ? 5 : 6,
        driftFreq: Math.random() * 0.02,
        driftPhase: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
        opacity: isFire ? (0.65 + Math.random() * 0.35) : (0.25 + Math.random() * 0.35),
        hue: isFire ? (Math.random() > 0.25 ? Math.floor(12 + Math.random() * 23) : Math.floor(35 + Math.random() * 25)) : 0 
    };
}

function initMenuParticles() {
    menuAshArray = [];
    for(let i = 0; i < 450; i++) {
        menuAshArray.push(createMenuParticle(true));
    }
}
initMenuParticles();

function handleMenuParticles() {
    if (gameState === 'playing') return;
    pctx.clearRect(0, 0, pCanvas.width, pCanvas.height);
    pctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'screen';

    menuAshArray.forEach((p, idx) => {
        p.y -= p.speed;
        p.x += Math.sin(p.y * p.driftFreq + p.driftPhase) * 0.5;

        if (p.type === 'fire') {
            p.size -= 0.008;
            p.opacity -= 0.0025;
            
            if (p.y < -10 || p.size <= 0.2 || p.opacity <= 0) {
                menuAshArray[idx] = createMenuParticle(false);
                return;
            }
            
            pctx.fillStyle = `hsla(${p.hue}, 100%, 50%, ${p.opacity * (0.75 + Math.random() * 0.25)})`;
            pctx.fillRect(p.x, p.y, p.size, p.size);
        } else {
            if (p.y < -10) {
                menuAshArray[idx] = createMenuParticle(false);
                return;
            }
            
            pctx.fillStyle = `rgba(110, 105, 105, ${p.opacity})`;
            pctx.fillRect(p.x, p.y, p.size, p.size);
        }
    });

    pctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over';
}

function getEnemiesForWave(w) {
    if (w === 4) return 1;
    return BASE_ENEMIES + ((w - 1) * 5);
}

function triggerVoice(text) {
    const speech = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(text);
    speech.rate = 1.1; 
    speech.pitch = 0.7; 
    speech.volume = 0.5;
    window.speechSynthesis.speak(speech);
}

function initTDMMode() {
    tdmBlueScore = 0;
    tdmRedScore = 0;
    document.getElementById('tdm-blue-score').innerText = '0';
    document.getElementById('tdm-red-score').innerText = '0';
    showNotification("TEAM DEATHMATCH: FIRST TO 40", "#38bdf8");
    triggerVoice("Team Deathmatch engaged. Eliminate Red Syndicate operatives.");
    // Spawn 5 Allied Spec-Ops AI squadmates
    const allyNames = ["ALPHA-1", "BRAVO-2", "VIPER-3", "GHOST-4", "REAPER-5"];
    for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
        allies.push({
            name: allyNames[i],
            x: 2.5 + (i % 3) * 0.8,
            y: 2.5 + Math.floor(i / 3) * 0.8,
            health: 120,
            maxHealth: 120,
            lastShot: Date.now() + Math.random() * 800,
            animPhase: Math.random() * 6.28,
            renderX: 0,
            renderSize: 0
        });
    }
    // Spawn 6 Red Syndicate enemy operatives on opposite quadrant
    for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) spawnTDMOperative();
}

function spawnTDMOperative() {
    let ex, ey, tries = 0;
    do {
        ex = Math.random() * (MAP_SIZE - 3) + 1.5;
        ey = Math.random() * (MAP_SIZE - 3) + 1.5;
        tries++;
    } while (tries < 60 && (worldMap[Math.floor(ey)][Math.floor(ex)] !== 0 || Math.hypot(ex - player.x, ey - player.y) < 6));
    const names = ["SYNDICATE-01", "SYNDICATE-02", "KRAKEN-03", "COBRA-04", "SHADOW-05", "JACKAL-06"];
    enemies.push({
        x: ex, y: ey,
        name: names[Math.floor(Math.random() * names.length)],
        enemyKind: 'operative',
        health: 115,
        maxHealth: 115,
        lastShot: Date.now() + Math.random() * 1200,
        hitFlash: 0,
        isFiring: false,
        isBoss: false,
        isMelee: false,
        swingTime: 0,
        biteTime: 0,
        animPhase: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
        isDying: false,
        deathTimer: 0,
        scale: 1.0,
        renderX: 0,
        renderSize: 0
    });
}

function initExtractionMode() {
    coreExtracted = false;
    intelTerminals = [];
    // Place 3 encrypted server terminals around the map
    const spots = [
        { x: 13.5, y: 2.5 },
        { x: 2.5, y: 13.5 },
        { x: 10.5, y: 9.5 }
    ];
    spots.forEach((pt, idx) => {
        const gx = Math.floor(pt.x), gy = Math.floor(pt.y);
        worldMap[gy][gx] = 0;
        if (worldMap[gy][gx + 1] !== undefined && gx + 1 < MAP_SIZE - 1) worldMap[gy][gx + 1] = 3;
        intelTerminals.push({ id: idx + 1, x: pt.x, y: pt.y, hacked: false, progress: 0 });
    });
    extractionZone = { x: 13.5, y: 13.5, active: false, holdTimer: 0, holdRequired: 15 };
    worldMap[13][13] = 0;

    document.getElementById('extract-obj-title').innerText = "OBJECTIVE: HACK INTEL TERMINALS (0/3)";
    document.getElementById('extract-obj-sub').innerText = "Stand near glowing amber terminals & hold [F] to decrypt";
    document.getElementById('hack-progress-wrap').style.display = 'none';

    showNotification("EXTRACTION PROTOCOL INITIATED", "#fb923c");
    triggerVoice("Infiltrate the facility and decrypt all three intel terminals.");
    for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) spawnEnemy(false);
}


function startWave() {
    killsInWave = 0;
    enemiesSpawnedInWave = 0;
    enemies = [];
    
    if (wave === 4) {
        showNotification("BOSS FIGHT", "var(--damage-red)");
        triggerVoice("Extreme threat detected. Boss fight initiated.");
        screenShakeTime = 300; 
        spawnEnemy(true);
    } else {
        showNotification(`WAVE ${wave} ARRIVING`);
        for(let i=0; i<6; i++) spawnEnemy();
    }
    updateUI();
}

function spawnEnemy(isBoss = false) {
    if (enemiesSpawnedInWave >= getEnemiesForWave(wave)) return;
    let ex, ey;
    do {
        ex = Math.random() * (MAP_SIZE - 2) + 1;
        ey = Math.random() * (MAP_SIZE - 2) + 1;
    } while (worldMap[Math.floor(ey)][Math.floor(ex)] !== 0 || Math.hypot(ex-player.x, ey-player.y) < 5);
    
    // Vary enemies between skeletons and military zombies (~50/50 split for regular enemies)
    let enemyKind = isBoss ? 'boss' : (Math.random() < 0.5 ? 'zombie' : 'skeleton');
    let isMelee = (enemyKind === 'zombie') || (!isBoss && Math.random() < 0.25);

    // Apply scaling based on chosen difficulty settings
    const activeMod = difficultyModifiers[selectedDifficulty];
    let baseEnemyHealth = isBoss ? 1000 : ((enemyKind === 'zombie' ? 125 : 100) + activeMod.extraHealth);

    enemies.push({ 
        x: ex, y: ey, 
        enemyKind: enemyKind,
        health: baseEnemyHealth, 
        maxHealth: baseEnemyHealth,
        lastShot: Date.now() + (Math.random() * 2000), 
        hitFlash: 0, 
        isFiring: false,
        isBoss: isBoss,
        isMelee: isMelee,
        swingTime: 0,
        biteTime: 0,
        animPhase: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
        isDying: false,       
        deathTimer: 0,        
        scale: isBoss ? 2.0 : 1.0,
        renderX: 0,
        renderSize: 0
    });
    enemiesSpawnedInWave++;
}

function renderEquippedWeapon() {
    const activeGunSvg = WEAPON_SVGS[equippedWeapon.id] || GUN_SVG_MARKUP;
    if (player.currentWeapon === 'gun') {
        weaponSvg.innerHTML = activeGunSvg;
        swapPreviewCircle.innerHTML = `<svg viewBox="0 0 200 200" style="transform: scale(1.15) translateY(5px);">${MACHETE_SVG_MARKUP}</svg>`;
        crosshair.innerText = "⌖";
    } else {
        weaponSvg.innerHTML = MACHETE_SVG_MARKUP;
        swapPreviewCircle.innerHTML = `<svg viewBox="0 0 200 200" style="transform: scale(0.9) translateY(12px);">${activeGunSvg}</svg>`;
        crosshair.innerText = "✧";
    }
}

function switchWeapon() {
    if (player.reloading || player.isMeleeSwinging || player.isHealing) return;
    
    player.currentWeapon = (player.currentWeapon === 'gun') ? 'machete' : 'gun';
    isFiringContinuous = false;
    
    const pitchOffset = player.pitch * -0.15;
    weaponWrap.style.transition = "transform 0.15s ease-in";
    weaponWrap.style.transform = `translateX(-50%) translateY(${250 + pitchOffset}px)`;
    
    setTimeout(() => {
        renderEquippedWeapon();
        updateUI();
        weaponWrap.style.transition = "transform 0.15s ease-out";
        weaponWrap.style.transform = `translateX(-50%) translateY(${pitchOffset}px)`;
    }, 150);
}

function useMedkit() {
    const now = Date.now();
    if (now - player.lastMedkitTime < player.medkitCooldown || player.isHealing || player.reloading) return;
    if (player.health >= equippedArmor.maxHp) {
        showNotification("ARMOR AT MAX CAPACITY", "var(--tactical-green)");
        return;
    }

    player.isHealing = true;
    isFiringContinuous = false;
    player.lastMedkitTime = now;

    const pitchOffset = player.pitch * -0.15;
    weaponWrap.style.transition = "transform 0.25s ease-in";
    weaponWrap.style.transform = `translateX(-50%) translateY(${300 + pitchOffset}px)`;

    setTimeout(() => {
        medkitUseWrap.classList.add('using');
        
        setTimeout(() => {
            medkitUseWrap.classList.add('healing-shake');
            triggerVoice("Armor integrity structural integrity restored");
            showNotification("ARMOR RECONSTRUCTED", "var(--tactical-green)");
            
            healFlashVignette.classList.remove('healing-flash-active');
            void healFlashVignette.offsetWidth; 
            healFlashVignette.classList.add('healing-flash-active');

            player.health = equippedArmor.maxHp;
            updateUI();

            setTimeout(() => {
                medkitUseWrap.classList.remove('healing-shake');
                medkitUseWrap.classList.remove('using');
                
                setTimeout(() => {
                    const endPitch = player.pitch * -0.15;
                    weaponWrap.style.transition = "transform 0.25s ease-out";
                    weaponWrap.style.transform = `translateX(-50%) translateY(${endPitch}px)`;
                    player.isHealing = false;
                }, 200);
            }, 1000);
        }, 400);
    }, 150);
}

function updateUI() {
    const healthPercent = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, Math.floor((player.health / equippedArmor.maxHp) * 100)));
    const healthBarFill = document.getElementById('health-bar-fill');
    const healthBarContainer = document.getElementById('health-bar-container');
    const healthText = document.getElementById('health-text');
    
    healthBarFill.style.width = healthPercent + "%";
    healthText.innerText = healthPercent + "%";

    const isRegenerating = (Date.now() - player.lastDamageTime > 6000 && player.health < equippedArmor.maxHp);

    if (healthPercent >= 60) {
        healthBarFill.style.backgroundColor = "var(--tactical-green)";
        healthText.style.color = "var(--tactical-green)";
    } else if (healthPercent >= 30) {
        healthBarFill.style.backgroundColor = "var(--damage-orange)";
        healthText.style.color = "var(--damage-orange)";
    } else {
        healthBarFill.style.backgroundColor = "var(--damage-red)";
        healthText.style.color = "var(--damage-red)";
    }

    if (healthPercent < 50) {
        bottomLeftHUD.classList.add('expanded');
        topHUD.classList.add('shrunk');
    } else {
        bottomLeftHUD.classList.remove('expanded');
        topHUD.classList.remove('shrunk');
    }

    if (isRegenerating) {
        healthBarContainer.style.borderColor = "var(--regen-blue)";
    } else {
        healthBarContainer.style.borderColor = "#444";
    }

    let remainingSkeletons = getEnemiesForWave(wave) - killsInWave;

    if (player.currentWeapon === 'gun') {
        document.getElementById('hud-ammo').innerText = `${player.ammo}/${equippedWeapon.mag}`;
    } else {
        document.getElementById('hud-ammo').innerText = `MELEE`;
    }
    
    const activeMod = difficultyModifiers[selectedDifficulty];
    const diffDisplay = document.getElementById('hud-diff');
    diffDisplay.innerText = selectedDifficulty;
    diffDisplay.style.color = activeMod.labelColor;

    if (currentGameMode === 'tdm') {
        document.getElementById('hud-wave').innerText = `TDM 6v6`;
        document.getElementById('hud-kills').innerText = killsInWave;
        document.getElementById('hud-remain').innerText = `${TDM_WIN_SCORE - tdmBlueScore} TO WIN`;
    } else if (currentGameMode === 'extraction') {
        const hackedCnt = intelTerminals.filter(t => t.hacked).length;
        document.getElementById('hud-wave').innerText = `EXTRACT`;
        document.getElementById('hud-kills').innerText = killsInWave;
        document.getElementById('hud-remain').innerText = `${hackedCnt}/3 INTEL`;
    } else {
        document.getElementById('hud-wave').innerText = `${wave}/${MAX_WAVES}`;
        document.getElementById('hud-kills').innerText = killsInWave;
        document.getElementById('hud-remain').innerText = Math.max(0, remainingSkeletons);
    }

    const stamFill = document.getElementById('stamina-bar-fill');
    if (stamFill) stamFill.style.width = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, stamina)) + '%';

    const ksUav = document.getElementById('ks-uav');
    const ksAir = document.getElementById('ks-airstrike');
    const ksOvr = document.getElementById('ks-overdrive');
    if (ksUav) ksUav.classList.toggle('unlocked', killStreakCount >= 3);
    if (ksAir) ksAir.classList.toggle('unlocked', killStreakCount >= 6);
    if (ksOvr) ksOvr.classList.toggle('unlocked', killStreakCount >= 9);
    
    updateAuxiliaryCooldowns();
}

function endMatchVictory(headline) {
    credits += 1200;
    updateCreditsUI();
    gameState = 'win';
    isFiringContinuous = false;
    setADS(false);
    document.exitPointerLock();
    overlay.style.display = 'flex';
    topHUD.style.display = 'none';
    bottomLeftHUD.style.display = 'none';
    bottomMiddleHUD.style.display = 'none';
    bottomRightHUD.style.display = 'none';
    centerReloadHUD.style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('tdm-scoreboard').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('extraction-hud').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('killstreak-hud').style.display = 'none';

    menuOptionsContainer.style.display = 'none';
    difficultyOptionsContainer.style.display = 'none';
    deathNoticeSub.style.display = 'block';
    deathNoticeSub.innerText = "CLICK TO GO BACK TO THE MAIN MENU";

    overlayTitle.innerText = headline;
    overlayTitle.style.color = "var(--tactical-green)";
}

function updateAuxiliaryCooldowns() {
    const now = Date.now();
    
    const grenadeElapsed = now - player.lastGrenadeTime;
    if (grenadeElapsed < player.grenadeCooldown) {
        const grenadeLeft = ((player.grenadeCooldown - grenadeElapsed) / 1000).toFixed(1);
        cooldownStatus.innerText = `GRENADE: ${grenadeLeft}s`;
        cooldownStatus.className = "status-charging";
    } else {
        cooldownStatus.innerText = "GRENADE: READY";
        cooldownStatus.className = "status-ready";
    }

    const medkitElapsed = now - player.lastMedkitTime;
    if (medkitElapsed < player.medkitCooldown) {
        const medkitLeft = Math.ceil((player.medkitCooldown - medkitElapsed) / 1000);
        medkitCooldownText.innerText = `${medkitLeft}s`;
        medkitCooldownText.classList.add('active');
        medkitCircle.style.borderColor = "var(--damage-orange)";
    } else {
        medkitCooldownText.classList.remove('active');
        medkitCircle.style.borderColor = "var(--tactical-green)";
    }
}

function registerPlayerDamage(amount) {
    if (player.isHealing) return; 
    const mitigatedDamage = Number((amount * (1 - equippedArmor.reduction)).toFixed(2));
    player.health = Math.max(0, player.health - mitigatedDamage);
    player.lastDamageTime = Date.now();
    
    if (player.health < 50) {
        damageVignette.classList.remove('blood-pulse');
        void damageVignette.offsetWidth; 
        damageVignette.classList.add('blood-pulse');
        
        clearTimeout(vignetteTimeout);
        vignetteTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
            damageVignette.classList.remove('blood-pulse');
        }, 50); 
    }

    updateUI();
    checkGameOver();
}

function handleRegeneration() {
    const now = Date.now();
    if (now - player.lastDamageTime > 6000) {
        if (player.health < equippedArmor.maxHp && now - player.lastRegenTick > 1000) {
            player.health = Math.min(equippedArmor.maxHp, player.health + 5); 
            player.lastRegenTick = now;
            updateUI();
        }
    }
}

function checkGameOver() {
    if (player.health <= 0) {
        if (currentGameMode === 'tdm') {
            if (playerRespawnTimer > 0) return;
            playerRespawnTimer = 180; // 3 seconds respawn
            isFiringContinuous = false;
            setADS(false);
            tdmRedScore++;
            document.getElementById('tdm-red-score').innerText = tdmRedScore;
            addKillFeed("RED SYNDICATE eliminated YOU", "#f87171");
            document.getElementById('respawn-banner').style.display = 'block';
            if (tdmRedScore >= TDM_WIN_SCORE) {
                document.getElementById('respawn-banner').style.display = 'none';
            } else {
                return;
            }
        }
        document.getElementById('tdm-scoreboard').style.display = 'none';
        document.getElementById('extraction-hud').style.display = 'none';
        document.getElementById('killstreak-hud').style.display = 'none';
        gameState = 'over';
        isFiringContinuous = false;
        document.exitPointerLock();
        
        gameContainer.classList.add('death-border');
        gameContainer.style.cursor = 'pointer';

        overlay.style.display = 'flex';
        topHUD.style.display = 'none';
        bottomLeftHUD.style.display = 'none';
        bottomMiddleHUD.style.display = 'none';
        bottomRightHUD.style.display = 'none';
        centerReloadHUD.style.display = 'none';
        
        menuOptionsContainer.style.display = 'none';
        difficultyOptionsContainer.style.display = 'none';
        deathNoticeSub.style.display = 'block';
        deathNoticeSub.innerText = "CLICK TO GO BACK TO THE MAIN MENU";

        overlayTitle.innerText = "You're dead";
        overlayTitle.style.color = "var(--damage-red)";
        overlayTitle.style.textShadow = "0 0 15px rgba(255, 0, 0, 0.7)";
    }
}

function reload() {
    if (player.currentWeapon !== 'gun' || player.reloading || player.isMeleeSwinging || player.isHealing) return;
    player.reloading = true;
    isFiringContinuous = false; 
    triggerVoice("Reloading");
    TacticalAudio.playMetallicClick(1400, 0.06, 0.3);
    
    centerReloadHUD.style.display = 'block';

    const magGroup = document.getElementById('weapon-mag-group');
    const handGroup = document.getElementById('reload-hand-group');
    const startPitch = player.pitch * -0.15;

    // Step 1: Tilt gun to the side in clear view & bring support hand up to grab the magazine
    weaponWrap.style.transition = "transform 0.22s cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.9, 0.35, 1)";
    weaponWrap.style.transform = `translateX(-42%) translateY(${startPitch - 25}px) rotate(-24deg) scale(1.06)`;
    if (handGroup) {
        handGroup.style.opacity = '1';
        handGroup.style.transform = 'translate(16px, -6px) rotate(0deg)';
    }

    // Step 2: Pull the empty magazine downward and out of the magwell
    setTimeout(() => {
        if (magGroup) {
            magGroup.style.transition = "transform 0.24s ease-in, opacity 0.18s ease 0.08s";
            magGroup.style.transform = "translate(-18px, 85px) rotate(-18deg)";
            magGroup.style.opacity = "0";
        }
        if (handGroup) {
            handGroup.style.transform = "translate(-10px, 78px) rotate(-14deg)";
        }

        // Step 3: Bring a fresh magazine up in hand and insert it into the receiver
        setTimeout(() => {
            if (magGroup) {
                magGroup.style.transition = "none";
                magGroup.style.transform = "translate(-16px, 82px) rotate(-12deg)";
                magGroup.style.opacity = "1";
                void magGroup.getBoundingClientRect();
                magGroup.style.transition = "transform 0.24s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.95, 0.3, 1.05)";
                magGroup.style.transform = "translate(0px, 0px) rotate(0deg)";
            }
            if (handGroup) {
                handGroup.style.transform = "translate(16px, -8px) rotate(0deg)";
            }

            // Step 4: Slap/seat the magazine firmly, drop support hand, and level weapon
            setTimeout(() => {
                const midPitch = player.pitch * -0.15;
                weaponWrap.style.transition = "transform 0.09s ease-out";
                weaponWrap.style.transform = `translateX(-43%) translateY(${midPitch - 34}px) rotate(-21deg) scale(1.07)`;

                if (handGroup) {
                    handGroup.style.opacity = "0";
                    handGroup.style.transform = "translate(-55px, 95px) rotate(-18deg)";
                }

                player.ammo = equippedWeapon.mag;
                centerReloadHUD.style.display = 'none';
                updateUI();

                setTimeout(() => {
                    const endPitch = player.pitch * -0.15;
                    weaponWrap.style.transition = "transform 0.2s ease-out";
                    weaponWrap.style.transform = `translateX(-50%) translateY(${endPitch}px) rotate(0deg) scale(1)`;
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        weaponWrap.style.transition = "transform 0.1s ease-out";
                        player.reloading = false;
                    }, 200);
                }, 110);
            }, 260);
        }, 260);
    }, 220);
}

function shoot() {
    if (player.reloading || player.isMeleeSwinging || player.isHealing) return;

    if (player.currentWeapon === 'machete') {
        executeMacheteSwing();
        return;
    }

    if (player.ammo <= 0) {
        isFiringContinuous = false;
        reload();
        return;
    }

    player.ammo--;
    updateUI();
    player.pitch += 6; 
    
    const currentPitchOffset = player.pitch * -0.15;
    weaponWrap.style.transition = "none";
    weaponWrap.style.transform = `translateX(-50%) translateY(${currentPitchOffset + 10}px) scale(1.03)`;
    setTimeout(() => {
        weaponWrap.style.transition = "transform 0.05s ease-out";
        weaponWrap.style.transform = `translateX(-50%) translateY(${player.pitch * -0.15}px) scale(1)`;
    }, 30);

    TacticalAudio.playGunshot(equippedWeapon.id);
    // Animate bolt reciprocation on SVG
    const boltEl = document.getElementById('weapon-bolt-group');
    if (boltEl) {
        boltEl.setAttribute('transform', 'translate(0, 7)');
        setTimeout(() => { if (boltEl) boltEl.setAttribute('transform', 'translate(0, 0)'); }, 45);
    }

    // Spawn ejecting spinning brass casing on screen
    shellCasings.push({
        x: canvas.width * 0.56,
        y: canvas.height * 0.72,
        vx: 4.5 + Math.random() * 3.5,
        vy: -5.5 - Math.random() * 3.0,
        rot: Math.random() * 6.28,
        vrot: 0.35 + Math.random() * 0.3,
        life: 45
    });

    // Spawn luminous 3D tracer streak
    bulletTracers.push({
        x: player.x + Math.cos(player.dir) * 0.4,
        y: player.y + Math.sin(player.dir) * 0.4,
        vx: Math.cos(player.dir) * 1.15,
        vy: Math.sin(player.dir) * 1.15,
        life: 14
    });

    muzzle.style.display = 'block';
    setTimeout(() => muzzle.style.display = 'none', 30);

    const effectiveDmg = (Date.now() < overdriveActiveUntil) ? Math.round(equippedWeapon.dmg * 1.65) : equippedWeapon.dmg;
    evaluateHitscanDamage(isADS ? 22 : 16, effectiveDmg);
}

function executeMacheteSwing() {
    player.isMeleeSwinging = true;
    isFiringContinuous = false;

    const pitchOffset = player.pitch * -0.15;
    weaponWrap.style.transition = "transform 0.08s cubic-bezier(0.15, 0.85, 0.35, 1.2)";
    weaponWrap.style.transform = `translateX(-30%) translateY(${pitchOffset - 20}px) rotate(35deg) scale(1.15)`;
    
    setTimeout(() => {
        weaponWrap.style.transition = "transform 0.05s ease-in";
        weaponWrap.style.transform = `translateX(-70%) translateY(${pitchOffset + 40}px) rotate(-45deg) scale(1.1)`;
        
        evaluateHitscanDamage(1.8, 50);

        setTimeout(() => {
            weaponWrap.style.transition = "transform 0.15s ease-out";
            weaponWrap.style.transform = `translateX(-50%) translateY(${pitchOffset}px) rotate(0deg) scale(1)`;
            setTimeout(() => {
                player.isMeleeSwinging = false;
            }, 150);
        }, 700);
    }, 80);
}

function evaluateHitscanDamage(maxRange, damageAmount) {
    let closestEnemy = null;
    let closestDistance = maxRange;
    const screenCenterX = canvas.width / 2;
    const screenCenterY = (canvas.height / 2) + player.pitch;

    enemies.forEach(en => {
        if (en.isDying || en.renderSize <= 0) return; 

        let dx = en.x - player.x, dy = en.y - player.y;
        let dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
        if (dist > closestDistance) return;

        const halfWidth = en.renderSize / 2;
        const topY = screenCenterY - (en.renderSize * 0.95);
        const bottomY = screenCenterY + (en.renderSize * 0.25);

        const withinX = screenCenterX >= (en.renderX - halfWidth) && screenCenterX <= (en.renderX + halfWidth);
        const withinY = screenCenterY >= topY && screenCenterY <= bottomY;

        if (withinX && withinY) {
            let angleToEn = Math.atan2(dy, dx);
            let clearShot = true;
            for(let d = 0.2; d < dist; d += 0.2) {
                let checkX = Math.floor(player.x + Math.cos(angleToEn) * d);
                let checkY = Math.floor(player.y + Math.sin(angleToEn) * d);
                if(worldMap[checkY] && worldMap[checkY][checkX] > 0) {
                    clearShot = false; 
                    break;
                }
            }
            
            if (clearShot) {
                closestEnemy = en;
                closestDistance = dist;
            }
        }
    });

    if (closestEnemy) {
        const isHeadshot = (screenCenterY < ((canvas.height / 2) + player.pitch) - closestEnemy.renderSize * 0.68);
        const appliedDmg = (player.currentWeapon === 'machete' && !closestEnemy.isBoss)
            ? closestEnemy.health
            : Math.round(damageAmount * (isHeadshot ? 1.45 : 1.0));

        closestEnemy.health -= appliedDmg;
        closestEnemy.hitFlash = 3;
        showHitmarker(isHeadshot || closestEnemy.health <= 0);

        floatingTexts.push({
            x: closestEnemy.renderX + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 24,
            y: (canvas.height / 2) + player.pitch - closestEnemy.renderSize * 0.75,
            text: isHeadshot ? `-${appliedDmg} CRIT!` : `-${appliedDmg}`,
            color: isHeadshot ? '#ff3131' : '#fbbf24',
            life: 32
        });

        if (closestEnemy.health <= 0) { 
            closestEnemy.isDying = true;
            closestEnemy.deathTimer = 30; 
            killsInWave++;
            killStreakCount++;
            credits += closestEnemy.isBoss ? 5000 : 350;
            updateCreditsUI();

            if (currentGameMode === 'tdm') {
                tdmBlueScore++;
                document.getElementById('tdm-blue-score').innerText = tdmBlueScore;
                addKillFeed(`YOU eliminated ${closestEnemy.name || 'SYNDICATE OP'}`, '#38bdf8');
                setTimeout(spawnTDMOperative, 1800);
                if (tdmBlueScore >= TDM_WIN_SCORE) {
                    endMatchVictory("ALLIED VICTORY (40-KILL TARGET REACHED)");
                    return;
                }
            } else if (currentGameMode === 'extraction') {
                addKillFeed(`YOU neutralized Hostile Guard (+$350)`, '#fb923c');
            } else {
                addKillFeed(`YOU eliminated ${closestEnemy.isBoss ? 'OVERLORD BOSS' : 'Hostile'}`, 'var(--tactical-green)');
                checkWaveProgress();
            }
            updateUI();
        }
    }
}

function throwGrenade() {
    const now = Date.now();
    if (now - player.lastGrenadeTime < player.grenadeCooldown || player.isHealing) return; 

    player.lastGrenadeTime = now;
    grenadeArmWrap.classList.add('throwing');
    
    setTimeout(() => {
        const launchForce = 0.12;
        grenades.push({
            x: player.x,
            y: player.y,
            vx: Math.cos(player.dir) * launchForce,
            vy: Math.sin(player.dir) * launchForce,
            life: 45 
        });
        updateUI();
        
        setTimeout(() => {
            grenadeArmWrap.classList.remove('throwing');
        }, 150);
    }, 200);
}

function processExplosion(gx, gy) {
    screenShakeTime = 25; 
    const blastRadius = 3.0;

    // Create 3D billboard explosion with expanding shockwave, fireball layers, and flying shrapnel/sparks
    const sparks = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < 28; i++) {
        const ang = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
        const speed = 0.3 + Math.random() * 1.1;
        sparks.push({
            angle: ang,
            speed: speed,
            size: 0.04 + Math.random() * 0.06,
            isEmber: Math.random() > 0.35
        });
    }
    explosions.push({
        x: gx,
        y: gy,
        life: 28,
        maxLife: 28,
        scale: 1.6,
        sparks: sparks
    });
    
    const playerDist = Math.hypot(player.x - gx, player.y - gy);
    if (playerDist <= blastRadius) {
        const damagePercentage = 1.0 - (playerDist / blastRadius);
        const playerDamage = Math.floor(damagePercentage * 60); 
        if (playerDamage > 5) registerPlayerDamage(playerDamage);
    }

    enemies.forEach(en => {
        if (en.isDying) return;
        const enemyDist = Math.hypot(en.x - gx, en.y - gy);
        if (enemyDist <= blastRadius) {
            const damagePercentage = 1.0 - (enemyDist / blastRadius);
            const explosiveDamage = Math.floor(damagePercentage * 250); 
            
            if (explosiveDamage > 10) {
                en.health -= explosiveDamage;
                en.hitFlash = 5;
                if (en.health <= 0) {
                    en.isDying = true;
                    en.deathTimer = 30;
                    killsInWave++;
                    credits += en.isBoss ? 5000 : 300;
                    updateCreditsUI();
                    updateUI();
                    checkWaveProgress();
                }
            }
        }
    });
}

function checkWaveProgress() {
    if (killsInWave >= getEnemiesForWave(wave)) {
        credits += 500;
        updateCreditsUI();
        if (wave < MAX_WAVES) {
            showNotification("WAVE COMPLETE (+500 CREDITS)", "#fbbf24");
            wave++;
            setTimeout(startWave, 2000);
        } else {
            showNotification("+500 CREDITS", "#fbbf24");
            gameState = 'win';
            isFiringContinuous = false;
            document.exitPointerLock();
            overlay.style.display = 'flex';
            topHUD.style.display = 'none';
            bottomLeftHUD.style.display = 'none';
            bottomMiddleHUD.style.display = 'none';
            bottomRightHUD.style.display = 'none';
            centerReloadHUD.style.display = 'none';
            
            menuOptionsContainer.style.display = 'none';
            difficultyOptionsContainer.style.display = 'none';
            deathNoticeSub.style.display = 'block';
            deathNoticeSub.innerText = "CLICK TO GO BACK TO THE MAIN MENU";

            overlayTitle.innerText = "MISSION SUCCESS";
            overlayTitle.style.color = "var(--tactical-green)";
        }
    }
}

function generateMap() {
    worldMap = Array.from({length: MAP_SIZE}, () => Array(MAP_SIZE).fill(0));
    for (let y = 0; y < MAP_SIZE; y++) {
        for (let x = 0; x < MAP_SIZE; x++) {
            if (x === 0 || x === MAP_SIZE-1 || y === 0 || y === MAP_SIZE-1) worldMap[y][x] = 1;
            else if (Math.random() < 0.15) worldMap[y][x] = Math.random() > 0.5 ? 1 : 2;
        }
    }
    worldMap[2][2] = 0; worldMap[3][2] = 0; worldMap[2][3] = 0;
}

function update() {
    handleMenuParticles();
    if (gameState !== 'playing') return;
    
    handleRegeneration();
    updateAuxiliaryCooldowns();

    if (isFiringContinuous && !player.reloading && player.currentWeapon === 'gun' && !player.isHealing) {
        const now = Date.now();
        if (now - lastAutoShotTime >= equippedWeapon.rate) {
            shoot();
            lastAutoShotTime = now;
        }
    }

    if (player.pitch > 0) player.pitch *= 0.85; 
    if (player.pitch < 0) player.pitch *= 0.85;

    if (screenShakeTime > 0) {
        screenShakeTime--;
        canvas.style.transform = `translate(${(Math.random()-0.5)*15}px, ${(Math.random()-0.5)*15}px)`;
    } else {
        canvas.style.transform = `translate(0,0)`;
    }

    // Handle TDM respawn countdown
    if (currentGameMode === 'tdm' && playerRespawnTimer > 0) {
        playerRespawnTimer--;
        document.getElementById('respawn-banner').innerText = `RESPAWNING IN ${Math.ceil(playerRespawnTimer / 60)}...`;
        if (playerRespawnTimer <= 0) {
            document.getElementById('respawn-banner').style.display = 'none';
            player.health = equippedArmor.maxHp;
            player.ammo = equippedWeapon.mag;
            player.x = 2.5; player.y = 2.5;
            updateUI();
        }
        return;
    }

    // Sprint & Stamina + Crouch mechanics
    const wantsSprint = (keys['ShiftLeft'] || keys['ShiftRight']) && keys['KeyW'] && !isADS && !player.reloading && !player.isHealing;
    if (wantsSprint && stamina > 5) {
        isSprinting = true;
        isCrouching = false;
        stamina = Math.max(0, stamina - 0.55);
        weaponWrap.classList.add('sprinting');
    } else {
        isSprinting = false;
        stamina = Math.min(100, stamina + 0.35);
        weaponWrap.classList.remove('sprinting');
    }
    const stamFill = document.getElementById('stamina-bar-fill');
    if (stamFill) stamFill.style.width = stamina + '%';

    const speedMult = (Date.now() < overdriveActiveUntil ? 1.35 : 1.0) * (isSprinting ? 1.55 : (isCrouching ? 0.6 : (isADS ? 0.72 : 1.0)));
    const curSpeed = player.speed * speedMult;

    let mx = 0, my = 0;
    if (keys['KeyW']) { mx += Math.cos(player.dir) * curSpeed; my += Math.sin(player.dir) * curSpeed; }
    if (keys['KeyS']) { mx -= Math.cos(player.dir) * curSpeed; my -= Math.sin(player.dir) * curSpeed; }
    if (keys['KeyA']) { mx += Math.cos(player.dir - 1.57) * curSpeed; my += Math.sin(player.dir - 1.57) * curSpeed; }
    if (keys['KeyD']) { mx += Math.cos(player.dir + 1.57) * curSpeed; my += Math.sin(player.dir + 1.57) * curSpeed; }

    if (worldMap[Math.floor(player.y)][Math.floor(player.x + mx)] === 0) player.x += mx;
    if (worldMap[Math.floor(player.y + my)][Math.floor(player.x)] === 0) player.y += my;

    // Update shell casings, bullet tracers & floating damage numbers
    for (let i = shellCasings.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        let sc = shellCasings[i];
        sc.x += sc.vx; sc.y += sc.vy; sc.vy += 0.55; sc.rot += sc.vrot; sc.life--;
        if (sc.life <= 0) shellCasings.splice(i, 1);
    }
    for (let i = bulletTracers.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        let tr = bulletTracers[i];
        tr.x += tr.vx; tr.y += tr.vy; tr.life--;
        if (tr.life <= 0 || (worldMap[Math.floor(tr.y)] && worldMap[Math.floor(tr.y)][Math.floor(tr.x)] > 0)) {
            bulletTracers.splice(i, 1);
        }
    }
    for (let i = floatingTexts.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        floatingTexts[i].y -= 1.1; floatingTexts[i].life--;
        if (floatingTexts[i].life <= 0) floatingTexts.splice(i, 1);
    }

    // TDM Allied Spec-Ops AI Squad Logic
    if (currentGameMode === 'tdm') {
        allies.forEach(al => {
            let nearest = null, minD = 999;
            enemies.forEach(en => {
                if (en.isDying) return;
                const d = Math.hypot(en.x - al.x, en.y - al.y);
                if (d < minD) { minD = d; nearest = en; }
            });
            if (nearest) {
                const ang = Math.atan2(nearest.y - al.y, nearest.x - al.x);
                if (minD > 3.2) {
                    const nx = al.x + Math.cos(ang) * 0.024;
                    const ny = al.y + Math.sin(ang) * 0.024;
                    if (worldMap[Math.floor(al.y)][Math.floor(nx)] === 0) al.x = nx;
                    if (worldMap[Math.floor(ny)][Math.floor(al.x)] === 0) al.y = ny;
                }
                if (minD < 10 && Date.now() - al.lastShot > 950) {
                    al.lastShot = Date.now();
                    bulletTracers.push({ x: al.x, y: al.y, vx: Math.cos(ang) * 0.9, vy: Math.sin(ang) * 0.9, life: 12, isAlly: true });
                    if (Math.random() < 0.45) {
                        nearest.health -= 24;
                        nearest.hitFlash = 2;
                        if (nearest.health <= 0 && !nearest.isDying) {
                            nearest.isDying = true;
                            nearest.deathTimer = 30;
                            tdmBlueScore++;
                            document.getElementById('tdm-blue-score').innerText = tdmBlueScore;
                            addKillFeed(`${al.name} eliminated ${nearest.name || 'SYNDICATE OP'}`, '#38bdf8');
                            setTimeout(spawnTDMOperative, 1800);
                            if (tdmBlueScore >= TDM_WIN_SCORE) endMatchVictory("ALLIED VICTORY (40-KILL TARGET REACHED)");
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        });
    }

    // Extraction Protocol Terminal Hacking & LZ Hold Logic
    if (currentGameMode === 'extraction') {
        let nearTerminal = null;
        intelTerminals.forEach(t => {
            if (!t.hacked && Math.hypot(player.x - t.x, player.y - t.y) < 1.8) nearTerminal = t;
        });
        const progWrap = document.getElementById('hack-progress-wrap');
        const progFill = document.getElementById('hack-progress-fill');
        if (nearTerminal) {
            progWrap.style.display = 'block';
            if (keys['KeyF']) {
                nearTerminal.progress += 0.65;
                if (Math.floor(nearTerminal.progress) % 15 === 0) TacticalAudio.playMetallicClick(1700, 0.03, 0.15);
                if (nearTerminal.progress >= 100) {
                    nearTerminal.hacked = true;
                    nearTerminal.progress = 100;
                    progWrap.style.display = 'none';
                    TacticalAudio.playMetallicClick(2500, 0.12, 0.4);
                    const hackedCount = intelTerminals.filter(t => t.hacked).length;
                    addKillFeed(`INTEL TERMINAL #${nearTerminal.id} DECRYPTED (${hackedCount}/3)`, '#f59e0b');
                    updateUI();
                    if (hackedCount >= 3) {
                        extractionZone.active = true;
                        document.getElementById('extract-obj-title').innerText = "OBJECTIVE: REACH & HOLD EXTRACTION LZ (15s)";
                        document.getElementById('extract-obj-sub').innerText = "Move to the green extraction flare in the SE sector!";
                        showNotification("ALL INTEL SECURED — PROCEED TO EXTRACTION LZ!", "#00ff41");
                        triggerVoice("All data cores decrypted. Proceed to the extraction landing zone.");
                    } else {
                        document.getElementById('extract-obj-title').innerText = `OBJECTIVE: HACK INTEL TERMINALS (${hackedCount}/3)`;
                    }
                    // Spawn ambush squad on terminal completion
                    for (let k = 0; k < 3; k++) spawnEnemy(false);
                }
            }
            progFill.style.width = nearTerminal.progress + '%';
        } else {
            progWrap.style.display = 'none';
        }

        if (extractionZone.active) {
            const dLz = Math.hypot(player.x - extractionZone.x, player.y - extractionZone.y);
            if (dLz < 2.2) {
                extractionZone.holdTimer += 1 / 60;
                const rem = Math.max(0, Math.ceil(extractionZone.holdRequired - extractionZone.holdTimer));
                document.getElementById('extract-obj-title').innerText = `HOLDING EXTRACTION LZ — CHOPPER IN ${rem}s`;
                if (enemies.filter(e => !e.isDying).length < 5) spawnEnemy(false);
                if (extractionZone.holdTimer >= extractionZone.holdRequired) {
                    endMatchVictory("DATA CORE EXTRACTED — MISSION COMPLETE");
                }
            }
        }
    }

    for (let i = grenades.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        let g = grenades[i];
        let nex = g.x + g.vx;
        let ney = g.y + g.vy;
        
        if (worldMap[Math.floor(g.y)][Math.floor(nex)] > 0) { g.vx *= -0.6; nex = g.x; }
        if (worldMap[Math.floor(ney)][Math.floor(g.x)] > 0) { g.vy *= -0.6; ney = g.y; }
        
        g.x = nex; g.y = ney;
        g.vx *= 0.95; g.vy *= 0.95; 
        
        g.life--;
        if (g.life <= 0) {
            processExplosion(g.x, g.y);
            grenades.splice(i, 1);
        }
    }

    for (let i = explosions.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        explosions[i].life--;
        if (explosions[i].life <= 0) {
            explosions.splice(i, 1);
        }
    }

    for (let i = projectiles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        let p = projectiles[i];
        p.x += p.vx; p.y += p.vy;
        if (worldMap[Math.floor(p.y)][Math.floor(p.x)] > 0) { projectiles.splice(i, 1); continue; }
        if (Math.hypot(p.x - player.x, p.y - player.y) < 0.3) {
            projectiles.splice(i, 1);
            registerPlayerDamage(10);
            continue;
        }
        p.life--;
        if (p.life <= 0) projectiles.splice(i, 1);
    }

    for (let i = enemies.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        let en = enemies[i];
        
        if (en.isDying) {
            en.deathTimer--;
            if (en.deathTimer <= 0) {
                enemies.splice(i, 1);
                if (wave < 4) while(enemies.filter(e => !e.isDying).length < 6 && enemiesSpawnedInWave < getEnemiesForWave(wave)) spawnEnemy();
            }
            continue;
        }

        let dist = Math.hypot(player.x - en.x, player.y - en.y);
        if (en.hitFlash > 0) en.hitFlash--;
        if (en.swingTime > 0) en.swingTime--;
        if (en.biteTime > 0) en.biteTime--;

        let ang = Math.atan2(player.y - en.y, player.x - en.x);
        // Zombies shambling steadily, then lunging faster when close to bite
        let baseSpeed = en.isBoss ? 0.015 : (en.enemyKind === 'zombie' ? (dist < 3.5 ? 0.032 : 0.023) : (en.isMelee ? 0.025 : 0.02));
        // Subtle stride surge synced to walk cycle
        let strideBoost = 0.85 + 0.3 * Math.abs(Math.sin(Date.now() * 0.008 + en.animPhase));
        let speed = baseSpeed * strideBoost;
        
        let stopDist = en.enemyKind === 'zombie' ? 0.85 : 1.0;
        if (dist > stopDist) {
            let nex = en.x + Math.cos(ang) * speed;
            let ney = en.y + Math.sin(ang) * speed;
            if (worldMap[Math.floor(en.y)][Math.floor(nex)] === 0) en.x = nex;
            if (worldMap[Math.floor(ney)][Math.floor(en.x)] === 0) en.y = ney;
        }

        if (en.enemyKind === 'zombie') {
            if (dist <= 1.15 && Date.now() - en.lastShot > 1350) {
                en.biteTime = 24;
                en.lastShot = Date.now();
                screenShakeTime = 14;
                // Trigger visceral bite blood vignette flash even above 50% HP
                damageVignette.classList.remove('blood-pulse');
                void damageVignette.offsetWidth;
                damageVignette.classList.add('blood-pulse');
                clearTimeout(vignetteTimeout);
                vignetteTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
                    damageVignette.classList.remove('blood-pulse');
                }, 140);
                registerPlayerDamage(18);
            }
        } else if (en.isMelee) {
            if (dist <= 1.2 && Date.now() - en.lastShot > 1500) {
                en.swingTime = 20; 
                en.lastShot = Date.now();
                screenShakeTime = 10;
                registerPlayerDamage(15);
            }
        } else {
            // Apply unique attack rhythm modifiers relative to active risk level
            const activeMod = difficultyModifiers[selectedDifficulty];
            let fireRate = en.isBoss ? 800 : ((3000 - (wave * 200)) * activeMod.fireRateMultiplier);
            
            if (Date.now() - en.lastShot > fireRate) {
                en.isFiring = true;
                en.lastShot = Date.now();
                projectiles.push({
                    x: en.x, y: en.y,
                    vx: Math.cos(ang) * 0.15, vy: Math.sin(ang) * 0.15,
                    life: 150
                });
                setTimeout(() => en.isFiring = false, 150);
            }
        }
    }
}

function drawMinimap() {
    mctx.fillStyle = "rgba(5, 5, 5, 0.85)";
    mctx.fillRect(0, 0, minimapCanvas.width, minimapCanvas.height);

    const cellSize = minimapCanvas.width / MAP_SIZE;

    for (let y = 0; y < MAP_SIZE; y++) {
        for (let x = 0; x < MAP_SIZE; x++) {
            if (worldMap[y][x] === 1) {
                mctx.fillStyle = "#3a1515"; 
                mctx.fillRect(x * cellSize, y * cellSize, cellSize - 0.5, cellSize - 0.5);
            } else if (worldMap[y][x] === 2) {
                mctx.fillStyle = "#1e1e1e"; 
                mctx.fillRect(x * cellSize, y * cellSize, cellSize - 0.5, cellSize - 0.5);
            }
        }
    }

    grenades.forEach(g => {
        mctx.fillStyle = "#ffaa00";
        mctx.fillRect(g.x * cellSize - 2, g.y * cellSize - 2, 4, 4);
    });

    explosions.forEach(ex => {
        const progress = 1 - (ex.life / ex.maxLife);
        mctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(255, 120, 20, ${1 - progress})`;
        mctx.lineWidth = 2;
        mctx.beginPath();
        mctx.arc(ex.x * cellSize, ex.y * cellSize, (0.5 + progress * 3.0) * cellSize, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        mctx.stroke();
    });

    enemies.forEach(en => {
        if (en.isDying) return; 
        mctx.fillStyle = en.isBoss ? "#ff3131" : (en.enemyKind === 'zombie' ? "#84cc16" : "#ff5c5c");
        mctx.beginPath();
        let r = en.isBoss ? 4 : 2.5;
        mctx.arc(en.x * cellSize, en.y * cellSize, r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        mctx.fill();
    });

    const px = player.x * cellSize;
    const py = player.y * cellSize;

    mctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(0, 255, 65, 0.4)";
    mctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
    mctx.beginPath();
    mctx.moveTo(px, py);
    mctx.lineTo(px + Math.cos(player.dir) * 15, py + Math.sin(player.dir) * 15);
    mctx.stroke();

    // TDM Allies on minimap
    allies.forEach(al => {
        mctx.fillStyle = "#38bdf8";
        mctx.beginPath();
        mctx.arc(al.x * cellSize, al.y * cellSize, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        mctx.fill();
    });

    // Extraction terminals & LZ on minimap
    intelTerminals.forEach(t => {
        mctx.fillStyle = t.hacked ? "#00ff41" : "#f59e0b";
        mctx.fillRect(t.x * cellSize - 3, t.y * cellSize - 3, 6, 6);
    });
    if (extractionZone.active) {
        mctx.strokeStyle = "#00ff41";
        mctx.lineWidth = 2;
        mctx.beginPath();
        mctx.arc(extractionZone.x * cellSize, extractionZone.y * cellSize, 7, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        mctx.stroke();
    }

    // UAV Radar Sweep Ring
    if (Date.now() < uavActiveUntil) {
        const sweepR = ((Date.now() % 1500) / 1500) * minimapCanvas.width * 0.65;
        mctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.45)";
        mctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
        mctx.beginPath();
        mctx.arc(px, py, sweepR, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        mctx.stroke();
    }

    mctx.fillStyle = "var(--tactical-green)";
    mctx.beginPath();
    mctx.arc(px, py, 3.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    mctx.fill();
}

function draw() {
    if (gameState === 'menu') return;
    const crouchOffset = isCrouching ? -55 : 0;
    const horizon = (canvas.height / 2) + player.pitch + crouchOffset;
    const activeFov = isADS ? (equippedWeapon.id === 'barrett' ? 0.42 : (equippedWeapon.id === 'scar' ? 0.62 : gameFOV * 0.8)) : gameFOV;

    // Textured tactical floor & ceiling gradient
    const ceilGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, Math.max(1, horizon));
    ceilGrad.addColorStop(0, "#050608");
    ceilGrad.addColorStop(1, currentGameMode === 'tdm' ? "#0c1926" : "#180909");
    ctx.fillStyle = ceilGrad;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, Math.max(0, horizon));

    const floorGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, Math.max(0, horizon), 0, canvas.height);
    floorGrad.addColorStop(0, "#090a0d");
    floorGrad.addColorStop(1, "#1e2229");
    ctx.fillStyle = floorGrad;
    ctx.fillRect(0, Math.max(0, horizon), canvas.width, canvas.height);

    const fov = activeFov;
    const rayStep = 2; // Crisp textured 2px column sampling for high FPS + full texture detail
    for (let i = 0; i < canvas.width; i += rayStep) {
        let rayA = (player.dir - fov/2) + (i / canvas.width) * fov;
        let dist = 0, hit = 0, hitX = 0, hitY = 0;
        let cA = Math.cos(rayA), sA = Math.sin(rayA);
        while (hit === 0 && dist < 18) {
            dist += 0.04;
            hitX = player.x + cA * dist;
            hitY = player.y + sA * dist;
            let tx = Math.floor(hitX);
            let ty = Math.floor(hitY);
            if (worldMap[ty] && worldMap[ty][tx] > 0) hit = worldMap[ty][tx];
        }
        const corrDist = dist * Math.cos(rayA - player.dir);
        for (let k = 0; k < rayStep && (i + k) < canvas.width; k++) zBuffer[i + k] = corrDist;
        let h = canvas.height / corrDist;

        const tex = wallTextures[hit] || wallTextures[1];
        const fracX = hitX - Math.floor(hitX);
        const fracY = hitY - Math.floor(hitY);
        const wallU = (Math.abs(fracX - 0.5) > Math.abs(fracY - 0.5)) ? fracY : fracX;
        const texX = Math.floor(wallU * 63) & 63;

        ctx.drawImage(tex, texX, 0, 1, 64, i, horizon - h/2, rayStep, h);
        // Distance atmospheric fog shading
        const shade = Math.min(0.88, dist / 17.5);
        if (shade > 0.04) {
            ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(4, 5, 8, ${shade})`;
            ctx.fillRect(i, horizon - h/2, rayStep, h);
        }
    }

    let sprites = [
        ...enemies.map(e => ({...e, type: 'enemy'})),
        ...allies.map(a => ({...a, type: 'ally'})),
        ...intelTerminals.map(t => ({...t, type: 'terminal', scale: 0.9})),
        ...(extractionZone.active ? [{ x: extractionZone.x, y: extractionZone.y, type: 'lz', scale: 1.2 }] : []),
        ...projectiles.map(p => ({...p, type: 'projectile'})),
        ...bulletTracers.map(tr => ({...tr, type: 'tracer', scale: 0.15})),
        ...grenades.map(g => ({...g, type: 'grenade', scale: 0.3})),
        ...explosions.map(ex => ({...ex, type: 'explosion'}))
    ];
    sprites.sort((a,b) => Math.hypot(b.x-player.x, b.y-player.y) - Math.hypot(a.x-player.x, a.y-player.y));

    sprites.forEach(s => {
        let dx = s.x - player.x, dy = s.y - player.y;
        let dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
        let spriteAngle = Math.atan2(dy, dx) - player.dir;
        while(spriteAngle < -Math.PI) spriteAngle += Math.PI * 2;
        while(spriteAngle > Math.PI) spriteAngle -= Math.PI * 2;

        if (Math.abs(spriteAngle) < fov) {
            let spriteSize = (canvas.height / (dist * Math.cos(spriteAngle))) * (s.scale || 1);
            let xPos = (0.5 * (spriteAngle / (fov / 2)) + 0.5) * canvas.width;
            
            if (s.type === 'enemy') {
                const idx = enemies.findIndex(e => e.x === s.x && e.y === s.y);
                if (idx !== -1) {
                    enemies[idx].renderX = xPos;
                    enemies[idx].renderSize = spriteSize;
                }
            }

            if (dist < zBuffer[Math.floor(xPos)] + 0.5) {
                if (s.type === 'enemy') {
                    let hSlices = canvas.height / (dist * Math.cos(spriteAngle));
                    let footLine = horizon + hSlices / 2;
                    let baseLine = footLine; 

                    // Realistic locomotion & breathing/lunge kinematics
                    const now = Date.now();
                    const walkSpeed = s.enemyKind === 'zombie' ? 0.011 : 0.009;
                    const cycle = now * walkSpeed + (s.animPhase || 0);
                    const stride = s.isDying ? 0 : Math.sin(cycle);
                    const stepLift = s.isDying ? 0 : Math.abs(Math.cos(cycle));
                    // Natural vertical head/torso bob on each footstep + zombie hunch
                    const verticalBob = s.isDying ? 0 : (-stepLift * spriteSize * 0.028);
                    const torsoSway = s.isDying ? 0 : (stride * spriteSize * 0.025);
                    const hitRecoil = (!s.isDying && s.hitFlash > 0) ? (-spriteSize * 0.03) : 0;

                    // Ground contact shadow for depth & realism
                    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.48)";
                    ctx.beginPath();
                    ctx.ellipse(xPos, baseLine, spriteSize * 0.24, spriteSize * 0.055, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                    ctx.fill();

                    if (s.enemyKind === 'zombie') {
                        // === MILITARY ZOMBIE RENDER & BITE ANIMATION ===
                        let collapse = 0;
                        let bodyTilt = stride * 0.06;
                        if (s.isDying) {
                            const prog = (30 - s.deathTimer) / 30;
                            collapse = prog * (spriteSize * 0.58);
                            bodyTilt = prog * 1.35;
                        }

                        // Bite lunge forward scale & head snap
                        let biteProgress = 0;
                        let biteLungeScale = 1.0;
                        let jawOpen = spriteSize * 0.018;
                        if (s.biteTime > 0 && !s.isDying) {
                            // 24 -> 14: lunge & open jaw wide; 14 -> 0: snap jaws shut!
                            biteProgress = Math.sin(((24 - s.biteTime) / 24) * Math.PI);
                            biteLungeScale = 1.0 + biteProgress * 0.24;
                            jawOpen = (s.biteTime > 12)
                                ? (spriteSize * (0.02 + ((24 - s.biteTime) / 12) * 0.075))
                                : (spriteSize * Math.max(0.005, (s.biteTime / 12) * 0.085));
                        }

                        ctx.save();
                        ctx.translate(xPos + torsoSway * 0.5, baseLine + collapse);
                        ctx.rotate(bodyTilt);
                        ctx.scale(biteLungeScale, biteLungeScale);

                        const flash = s.hitFlash > 0;
                        const skinColor = flash ? "#ffffff" : "#6f8564";
                        const darkSkin = flash ? "#e5e5e5" : "#4b5c43";
                        const bduOlive = flash ? "#ffffff" : "#3a4632";
                        const bduCamo = flash ? "#dcdcdc" : "#263020";
                        const vestColor = flash ? "#f0f0f0" : "#1f241d";
                        const bloodRed = flash ? "#ff9999" : "#8a0b0b";

                        const bob = verticalBob + hitRecoil;

                        // Articulated Left & Right Legs (Thigh -> Knee -> Boot)
                        const leftKneeLift = Math.max(0, stride) * spriteSize * 0.06;
                        const rightKneeLift = Math.max(0, -stride) * spriteSize * 0.06;

                        // Left leg
                        ctx.fillStyle = bduOlive;
                        ctx.fillRect(-spriteSize * 0.13, -spriteSize * 0.36 + bob, spriteSize * 0.095, spriteSize * 0.19 - leftKneeLift * 0.4);
                        ctx.fillStyle = bduCamo;
                        ctx.fillRect(-spriteSize * 0.125, -spriteSize * 0.19 + bob - leftKneeLift * 0.4, spriteSize * 0.085, spriteSize * 0.15 - leftKneeLift * 0.4);
                        // Combat boot
                        ctx.fillStyle = "#141414";
                        ctx.fillRect(-spriteSize * 0.14, -spriteSize * 0.05 - leftKneeLift * 0.8, spriteSize * 0.105, spriteSize * 0.05);

                        // Right leg (zombie limp drag)
                        ctx.fillStyle = bduOlive;
                        ctx.fillRect(spriteSize * 0.035, -spriteSize * 0.36 + bob, spriteSize * 0.095, spriteSize * 0.19 - rightKneeLift * 0.25);
                        ctx.fillStyle = bduCamo;
                        ctx.fillRect(spriteSize * 0.04, -spriteSize * 0.19 + bob - rightKneeLift * 0.25, spriteSize * 0.085, spriteSize * 0.15 - rightKneeLift * 0.25);
                        ctx.fillStyle = "#141414";
                        ctx.fillRect(spriteSize * 0.035, -spriteSize * 0.05 - rightKneeLift * 0.5, spriteSize * 0.105, spriteSize * 0.05);

                        // Tactical Belt & Pouches
                        ctx.fillStyle = "#181a17";
                        ctx.fillRect(-spriteSize * 0.16, -spriteSize * 0.39 + bob, spriteSize * 0.32, spriteSize * 0.045);
                        ctx.fillStyle = "#2b3028";
                        ctx.fillRect(-spriteSize * 0.14, -spriteSize * 0.395 + bob, spriteSize * 0.07, spriteSize * 0.055);
                        ctx.fillRect(spriteSize * 0.07, -spriteSize * 0.395 + bob, spriteSize * 0.07, spriteSize * 0.055);

                        // Torso (Tattered Camo Uniform + Kevlar Plate Carrier)
                        ctx.fillStyle = bduOlive;
                        ctx.fillRect(-spriteSize * 0.18 + torsoSway * 0.3, -spriteSize * 0.72 + bob, spriteSize * 0.36, spriteSize * 0.34);
                        // Camo patches
                        ctx.fillStyle = bduCamo;
                        ctx.fillRect(-spriteSize * 0.16 + torsoSway * 0.3, -spriteSize * 0.68 + bob, spriteSize * 0.11, spriteSize * 0.12);
                        ctx.fillRect(spriteSize * 0.05 + torsoSway * 0.3, -spriteSize * 0.56 + bob, spriteSize * 0.11, spriteSize * 0.13);

                        // Kevlar Tactical Vest (ripped on one side)
                        ctx.fillStyle = vestColor;
                        ctx.fillRect(-spriteSize * 0.155 + torsoSway * 0.3, -spriteSize * 0.71 + bob, spriteSize * 0.31, spriteSize * 0.27);
                        // MOLLE webbing straps
                        ctx.fillStyle = "#111410";
                        ctx.fillRect(-spriteSize * 0.14 + torsoSway * 0.3, -spriteSize * 0.64 + bob, spriteSize * 0.28, spriteSize * 0.025);
                        ctx.fillRect(-spriteSize * 0.14 + torsoSway * 0.3, -spriteSize * 0.57 + bob, spriteSize * 0.28, spriteSize * 0.025);
                        ctx.fillRect(-spriteSize * 0.14 + torsoSway * 0.3, -spriteSize * 0.50 + bob, spriteSize * 0.28, spriteSize * 0.025);

                        // Battle wound / exposed necrotic flesh & blood on chest
                        ctx.fillStyle = bloodRed;
                        ctx.beginPath();
                        ctx.arc(spriteSize * 0.06 + torsoSway * 0.3, -spriteSize * 0.56 + bob, spriteSize * 0.055, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                        ctx.fill();
                        ctx.fillStyle = "#d6cfc2"; // exposed rib bone
                        ctx.fillRect(spriteSize * 0.03 + torsoSway * 0.3, -spriteSize * 0.575 + bob, spriteSize * 0.06, spriteSize * 0.012);
                        ctx.fillRect(spriteSize * 0.035 + torsoSway * 0.3, -spriteSize * 0.55 + bob, spriteSize * 0.055, spriteSize * 0.012);

                        // Shoulder Pads
                        ctx.fillStyle = vestColor;
                        ctx.fillRect(-spriteSize * 0.22 + torsoSway * 0.3, -spriteSize * 0.72 + bob, spriteSize * 0.07, spriteSize * 0.11);
                        ctx.fillRect(spriteSize * 0.15 + torsoSway * 0.3, -spriteSize * 0.72 + bob, spriteSize * 0.07, spriteSize * 0.11);

                        // Outstretched Lunging Zombie Arms (reach forward when biting!)
                        const armReach = biteProgress * spriteSize * 0.12;
                        const leftArmSwing = -stride * spriteSize * 0.045 - armReach * 0.5;
                        const rightArmSwing = stride * spriteSize * 0.045 - armReach * 0.5;

                        // Left arm + clawed hand
                        ctx.fillStyle = bduOlive;
                        ctx.fillRect(-spriteSize * 0.225 + torsoSway * 0.4, -spriteSize * 0.65 + bob + leftArmSwing, spriteSize * 0.065, spriteSize * 0.16);
                        ctx.fillStyle = skinColor;
                        ctx.fillRect(-spriteSize * 0.22 + torsoSway * 0.4, -spriteSize * 0.50 + bob + leftArmSwing, spriteSize * 0.058, spriteSize * 0.15 + armReach * 0.4);
                        ctx.fillStyle = bloodRed; // bloody fingertips
                        ctx.fillRect(-spriteSize * 0.22 + torsoSway * 0.4, -spriteSize * 0.36 + bob + leftArmSwing + armReach * 0.4, spriteSize * 0.058, spriteSize * 0.03);

                        // Right arm + clawed hand
                        ctx.fillStyle = bduOlive;
                        ctx.fillRect(spriteSize * 0.16 + torsoSway * 0.4, -spriteSize * 0.65 + bob + rightArmSwing, spriteSize * 0.065, spriteSize * 0.16);
                        ctx.fillStyle = skinColor;
                        ctx.fillRect(spriteSize * 0.162 + torsoSway * 0.4, -spriteSize * 0.50 + bob + rightArmSwing, spriteSize * 0.058, spriteSize * 0.15 + armReach * 0.4);
                        ctx.fillStyle = bloodRed;
                        ctx.fillRect(spriteSize * 0.162 + torsoSway * 0.4, -spriteSize * 0.36 + bob + rightArmSwing + armReach * 0.4, spriteSize * 0.058, spriteSize * 0.03);

                        // Neck & Head (hunched slightly forward, snapping down on bite)
                        const headNod = biteProgress * spriteSize * 0.04;
                        const headX = torsoSway * 0.6;
                        const headY = -spriteSize * 0.89 + bob + headNod;

                        ctx.fillStyle = darkSkin;
                        ctx.fillRect(headX - spriteSize * 0.05, -spriteSize * 0.76 + bob, spriteSize * 0.10, spriteSize * 0.06);

                        // Upper Cranium / Face
                        ctx.fillStyle = skinColor;
                        ctx.fillRect(headX - spriteSize * 0.095, headY, spriteSize * 0.19, spriteSize * 0.12);

                        // Military Kevlar Combat Helmet + Chin Strap + Cracked Visor
                        ctx.fillStyle = flash ? "#ffffff" : "#273322";
                        ctx.beginPath();
                        ctx.arc(headX, headY + spriteSize * 0.02, spriteSize * 0.118, Math.PI, 0);
                        ctx.fill();
                        ctx.fillRect(headX - spriteSize * 0.122, headY + spriteSize * 0.01, spriteSize * 0.244, spriteSize * 0.032);
                        // Helmet NVG mount
                        ctx.fillStyle = "#111";
                        ctx.fillRect(headX - spriteSize * 0.03, headY - spriteSize * 0.04, spriteSize * 0.06, spriteSize * 0.045);

                        // Glowing Infected Eyes
                        ctx.fillStyle = "#d9f99d";
                        ctx.fillRect(headX - spriteSize * 0.06, headY + spriteSize * 0.055, spriteSize * 0.035, spriteSize * 0.024);
                        ctx.fillRect(headX + spriteSize * 0.025, headY + spriteSize * 0.055, spriteSize * 0.035, spriteSize * 0.024);

                        // Snapping Mouth & Lower Jaw (opens wide and chomps during bite!)
                        const mouthTopY = headY + spriteSize * 0.105;
                        ctx.fillStyle = "#2b0505";
                        ctx.fillRect(headX - spriteSize * 0.065, mouthTopY, spriteSize * 0.13, jawOpen);

                        // Upper & Lower Jagged Teeth
                        ctx.fillStyle = "#ece6d5";
                        for (let t = -2; t <= 2; t++) {
                            ctx.fillRect(headX + t * spriteSize * 0.024 - spriteSize * 0.007, mouthTopY, spriteSize * 0.014, spriteSize * 0.016);
