                        const fx = -15.5 + (f / (fanCount - 1)) * 31;
                        const fy = 1.2 + tier * 1.1 + 0.65;
                        const fz = tier * 2.0;
                        const jerseyColor = fanColors[(f + tier + idx) % fanColors.length];
                        const fanMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: jerseyColor, roughness: 0.6 });
                        const fanMesh = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.28, 0.34, 1.15, 8), fanMat);
                        fanMesh.position.set(fx, fy, fz);
                        standGroup.add(fanMesh);

                        crowdAnimators.push({
                            mesh: fanMesh,
                            baseY: fy,
                            phase: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
                            speed: 5 + Math.random() * 4
                        });
                    }
                }

                // Grandstand Canopy Roof
                const canopy = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(35, 0.5, 9.5), roofMat);
                canopy.position.set(0, 7.6, 3.2);
                canopy.rotation.x = 0.14;
                standGroup.add(canopy);

                trackWorldGroup.add(standGroup);
            }

            // Ultra-Dense GPU-Instanced Environment Props (Buildings with Antennas & Lights / Trees / Rocks)
            const dummy = new THREE.Object3D();
            const colorObj = new THREE.Color();
            const isUrban = trackSpec.theme === 'NEON_CITY' || trackSpec.theme === 'HARBOR' || trackSpec.theme === 'GP_CIRCUIT';
            const isDesert = trackSpec.theme === 'DESERT';

            const propCount = gameSettings.graphics === 'LOW' ? 2400 : (gameSettings.graphics === 'MEDIUM' ? 5200 : 8800);

            if (isUrban) {
                const bldgGeo = new THREE.BoxGeometry(1, 1, 1);
                const bldgMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
                    map: createBuildingFacadeTexture(trackSpec.theme),
                    emissiveMap: createBuildingFacadeTexture(trackSpec.theme),
                    emissive: new THREE.Color(0xffffff),
                    emissiveIntensity: trackSpec.theme === 'NEON_CITY' ? 0.95 : 0.65,
                    roughness: 0.35,
                    metalness: 0.45
                });
                const instBuildings = new THREE.InstancedMesh(bldgGeo, bldgMat, propCount);
                instBuildings.castShadow = gameSettings.graphics === 'HIGH';
                instBuildings.receiveShadow = true;

                const antennaGeo = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.18, 0.45, 22, 6);
                const antennaMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x94a3b8, metalness: 0.8 });
                const instAntennas = new THREE.InstancedMesh(antennaGeo, antennaMat, Math.floor(propCount * 0.35));

                const beaconGeo = new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.75, 8, 8);
                const beaconMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xff1e1e });
                const instBeacons = new THREE.InstancedMesh(beaconGeo, beaconMat, Math.floor(propCount * 0.35));

                const palette = trackSpec.theme === 'NEON_CITY'
                    ? [0x1e293b, 0x0f172a, 0x312e81, 0x1e3a8a, 0x3b0764, 0x134e4a]
                    : (trackSpec.theme === 'HARBOR'
                        ? [0xfef3c7, 0xfde68a, 0xe0f2fe, 0xfecdd3, 0xf1f5f9, 0xdbeafe]
                        : [0x334155, 0x475569, 0x1e293b, 0x64748b, 0x94a3b8]);

                let antIdx = 0;
                for (let i = 0; i < propCount; i++) {
                    const s = trackSamples[Math.floor(Math.random() * SAMPLE_COUNT)];
                    const side = Math.random() > 0.5 ? 1 : -1;
                    const distFromCenter = halfW + 26 + Math.pow(Math.random(), 1.35) * 950;
                    const pos = s.pt.clone().addScaledVector(s.right, side * distFromCenter);

                    const w = 18 + Math.random() * 34;
                    const d = 18 + Math.random() * 34;
                    const h = (trackSpec.theme === 'NEON_CITY' ? 45 : 24) + Math.random() * 145;

                    dummy.position.set(pos.x, h * 0.5 - 0.15, pos.z);
                    dummy.rotation.set(0, Math.atan2(s.tan.x, s.tan.z), 0);
                    dummy.scale.set(w, h, d);
                    dummy.updateMatrix();
                    instBuildings.setMatrixAt(i, dummy.matrix);

                    colorObj.setHex(palette[i % palette.length]);
                    instBuildings.setColorAt(i, colorObj);

                    // Add Rooftop Antennas & Aviation Warning Lights on taller buildings
                    if (h > 65 && antIdx < instAntennas.count) {
                        dummy.position.set(pos.x, h + 10.5, pos.z);
                        dummy.rotation.set(0, 0, 0);
                        dummy.scale.set(1, 1, 1);
                        dummy.updateMatrix();
                        instAntennas.setMatrixAt(antIdx, dummy.matrix);

                        dummy.position.set(pos.x, h + 21.8, pos.z);
                        dummy.updateMatrix();
                        instBeacons.setMatrixAt(antIdx, dummy.matrix);
                        antIdx++;
                    }
                }
                instAntennas.count = antIdx;
                instBeacons.count = antIdx;
                instBuildings.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true;
                if (instBuildings.instanceColor) instBuildings.instanceColor.needsUpdate = true;
                instAntennas.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true;
                instBeacons.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true;

                trackWorldGroup.add(instBuildings);
                trackWorldGroup.add(instAntennas);
                trackWorldGroup.add(instBeacons);
            } else if (isDesert) {
                const mesaGeo = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.65, 1.0, 1, 7);
                const mesaMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xb45309, roughness: 0.92 });
                const instMesas = new THREE.InstancedMesh(mesaGeo, mesaMat, propCount);
                const desertPalette = [0xb45309, 0x9a3412, 0xc2410c, 0xd97706, 0x7c2d12];

                for (let i = 0; i < propCount; i++) {
                    const s = trackSamples[Math.floor(Math.random() * SAMPLE_COUNT)];
                    const side = Math.random() > 0.5 ? 1 : -1;
                    const distFromCenter = halfW + 24 + Math.pow(Math.random(), 1.3) * 1100;
                    const pos = s.pt.clone().addScaledVector(s.right, side * distFromCenter);

                    const rad = 12 + Math.random() * 48;
                    const h = 14 + Math.random() * 95;
                    dummy.position.set(pos.x, h * 0.5 - 0.2, pos.z);
                    dummy.rotation.set(0, Math.random() * Math.PI, 0);
                    dummy.scale.set(rad, h, rad);
                    dummy.updateMatrix();
                    instMesas.setMatrixAt(i, dummy.matrix);

                    colorObj.setHex(desertPalette[i % desertPalette.length]);
                    instMesas.setColorAt(i, colorObj);
                }
                instMesas.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true;
                if (instMesas.instanceColor) instMesas.instanceColor.needsUpdate = true;
                trackWorldGroup.add(instMesas);
            } else {
                // Alpine / Redwood Pine Forest
                const trunkGeo = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.45, 0.75, 8, 6);
                const trunkMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x451a03, roughness: 0.9 });
                const foliageGeo = new THREE.ConeGeometry(4.8, 18, 7);
                const foliageMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x15803d, roughness: 0.8 });

                const instTrunks = new THREE.InstancedMesh(trunkGeo, trunkMat, propCount);
                const instFoliage = new THREE.InstancedMesh(foliageGeo, foliageMat, propCount);
                const treeGreens = [0x14532d, 0x166534, 0x15803d, 0x065f46, 0x1e3a2f];

                for (let i = 0; i < propCount; i++) {
                    const s = trackSamples[Math.floor(Math.random() * SAMPLE_COUNT)];
                    const side = Math.random() > 0.5 ? 1 : -1;
                    const distFromCenter = halfW + 22 + Math.pow(Math.random(), 1.25) * 1050;
                    const pos = s.pt.clone().addScaledVector(s.right, side * distFromCenter);

                    const sc = 0.8 + Math.random() * 1.9;
                    dummy.position.set(pos.x, 4 * sc - 0.15, pos.z);
                    dummy.rotation.set(0, Math.random() * Math.PI, 0);
                    dummy.scale.set(sc, sc, sc);
                    dummy.updateMatrix();
                    instTrunks.setMatrixAt(i, dummy.matrix);

                    dummy.position.set(pos.x, 14 * sc - 0.15, pos.z);
                    dummy.updateMatrix();
                    instFoliage.setMatrixAt(i, dummy.matrix);

                    colorObj.setHex(treeGreens[i % treeGreens.length]);
                    instFoliage.setColorAt(i, colorObj);
                }
                instTrunks.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true;
                instFoliage.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true;
                if (instFoliage.instanceColor) instFoliage.instanceColor.needsUpdate = true;
                trackWorldGroup.add(instTrunks);
                trackWorldGroup.add(instFoliage);
            }

            // Trackside Floodlight Poles Along the Circuit
            const poleCount = 180;
            const poleGeo = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.18, 0.28, 12, 6);
            const poleMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x475569, metalness: 0.7 });
            const lampGeo = new THREE.BoxGeometry(1.4, 0.35, 0.6);
            const lampMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xfef9c3 });

            const instPoles = new THREE.InstancedMesh(poleGeo, poleMat, poleCount);
            const instLamps = new THREE.InstancedMesh(lampGeo, lampMat, poleCount);

            for (let i = 0; i < poleCount; i++) {
                const sIdx = Math.floor((i / poleCount) * SAMPLE_COUNT);
                const s = trackSamples[sIdx];
                const side = i % 2 === 0 ? 1 : -1;
                const pos = s.pt.clone().addScaledVector(s.right, side * (halfW + 3.2));
                const yaw = Math.atan2(s.tan.x, s.tan.z);

                dummy.position.set(pos.x, 6, pos.z);
                dummy.rotation.set(0, yaw, 0);
                dummy.scale.set(1, 1, 1);
                dummy.updateMatrix();
                instPoles.setMatrixAt(i, dummy.matrix);

                const lampPos = s.pt.clone().addScaledVector(s.right, side * (halfW + 2.4));
                dummy.position.set(lampPos.x, 11.9, lampPos.z);
                dummy.updateMatrix();
                instLamps.setMatrixAt(i, dummy.matrix);
            }
            instPoles.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true;
            instLamps.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true;
            trackWorldGroup.add(instPoles);
            trackWorldGroup.add(instLamps);

            applyWeatherEnvironment(gameSettings.weather);
        }

        function applyWeatherEnvironment(weatherKey) {
            gameSettings.weather = weatherKey;
            const track = currentTrackData || TRACK_DATABASE[0];
            const rainOverlay = document.getElementById('cockpit-rain-overlay');
            const weatherLabel = document.getElementById('hud-weather-label');
            const gripLabel = document.getElementById('hud-grip-label');

            let skyHex = track.skyTop;
            let fogHex = track.skyBottom;
            let fogDensity = 0.00022;
            let sunIntensity = 1.45;
            let sunColor = 0xfffbeb;
            let gripText = 'GRIP 100%';
            let gripColor = '#30d158';
            let labelText = '☀️ Clear';

            weatherParticles.visible = false;
            rainOverlay.style.opacity = '0';

            switch (weatherKey) {
                case 'SUNSET':
                    skyHex = 0x7c2d12;
                    fogHex = 0xfb923c;
                    fogDensity = 0.00028;
                    sunIntensity = 1.35;
                    sunColor = 0xfdba74;
                    labelText = '🌅 Sunset';
                    break;
                case 'OVERCAST':
                    skyHex = 0x475569;
                    fogHex = 0x94a3b8;
                    fogDensity = 0.00038;
                    sunIntensity = 0.85;
                    labelText = '☁️ Overcast';
                    break;
                case 'RAIN':
                    skyHex = 0x1e293b;
                    fogHex = 0x475569;
                    fogDensity = 0.00055;
                    sunIntensity = 0.65;
                    weatherParticles.visible = true;
                    weatherMat.color.setHex(0xbae6fd);
                    weatherMat.size = 0.42;
                    if (gameSettings.cameraMode === 'FIRST') rainOverlay.style.opacity = '0.85';
                    gripText = 'WET 84%';
                    gripColor = '#38bdf8';
                    labelText = '🌧️ Rain';
                    break;
                case 'STORM':
                    skyHex = 0x090d16;
                    fogHex = 0x1e293b;
                    fogDensity = 0.00072;
                    sunIntensity = 0.42;
                    weatherParticles.visible = true;
                    weatherMat.color.setHex(0xe0f2fe);
                    weatherMat.size = 0.5;
                    if (gameSettings.cameraMode === 'FIRST') rainOverlay.style.opacity = '1.0';
                    gripText = 'STORM 76%';
                    gripColor = '#f59e0b';
                    labelText = '⛈️ Storm';
                    break;
                case 'FOG':
                    skyHex = 0x94a3b8;
                    fogHex = 0xcbd5e1;
                    fogDensity = 0.00145;
                    sunIntensity = 0.75;
                    gripText = 'DAMP 92%';
                    labelText = '🌫️ Fog';
                    break;
                case 'SNOW':
                    skyHex = 0xcbd5e1;
                    fogHex = 0xf1f5f9;
                    fogDensity = 0.00065;
                    sunIntensity = 1.05;
                    weatherParticles.visible = true;
                    weatherMat.color.setHex(0xffffff);
                    weatherMat.size = 0.85;
                    gripText = 'ICE 70%';
                    gripColor = '#00e5ff';
                    labelText = '❄️ Snow';
                    break;
                default:
                    break;
            }

            scene.background = new THREE.Color(skyHex);
            scene.fog = new THREE.FogExp2(fogHex, fogDensity);
            sunLight.intensity = sunIntensity;
            sunLight.color.setHex(sunColor);

            if (weatherLabel) weatherLabel.textContent = labelText;
            if (gripLabel) {
                gripLabel.textContent = gripText;
                gripLabel.style.color = gripColor;
            }
        }

        /* ============================================================================
           7. GARAGE 3D SHOWCASE CAR & INTERACTIVE DRAG ROTATION
           ============================================================================ */
        let showcaseCarObj = null;
        let showcaseYaw = 0.65;
        let isDraggingShowcase = false;
        let prevMouseX = 0;

        const showcasePedestal = new THREE.Mesh(
            new THREE.CylinderGeometry(3.4, 3.7, 0.25, 48),
            new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x111827, metalness: 0.8, roughness: 0.2 })
        );
        showcasePedestal.position.y = -0.12;
        showcaseGroup.add(showcasePedestal);

        const pedestalRing = new THREE.Mesh(
            new THREE.RingGeometry(3.42, 3.56, 48),
            new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0x00e5ff, side: THREE.DoubleSide })
        );
        pedestalRing.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
        pedestalRing.position.y = 0.02;
        showcaseGroup.add(pedestalRing);

        function rebuildShowcaseCar() {
            if (showcaseCarObj) {
                showcaseGroup.remove(showcaseCarObj.mesh);
            }
            const car = getSelectedCar();
            showcaseCarObj = buildCarMesh(
                car,
                gameState.customColors.body,
                gameState.customColors.stripe,
                gameState.customColors.rim
            );
            showcaseGroup.add(showcaseCarObj.mesh);
        }

        renderer.domElement.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
            if (gameState.screen === 'MENU') {
                isDraggingShowcase = true;
                prevMouseX = e.clientX;
            }
        });
        window.addEventListener('mouseup', () => { isDraggingShowcase = false; });
        window.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
            if (isDraggingShowcase && gameState.screen === 'MENU') {
                showcaseYaw += (e.clientX - prevMouseX) * 0.01;
                prevMouseX = e.clientX;
            }
        });

        /* ============================================================================
           8. VEHICLE PHYSICS, 20-RACER ROLLING START & AI OPPONENTS
           ============================================================================ */
        let playerVehicle = null;
        let aiVehicles = [];

        function getSelectedCar() {
            return CAR_DATABASE.find(c => c.id === gameState.selectedCarId) || CAR_DATABASE[0];
        }

        function getUpgradedCarStats(baseCar) {
            const engBonus = gameState.upgrades.engine * 0.055;
            const trbBonus = gameState.upgrades.turbo * 0.06;
            const tireBonus = gameState.upgrades.tires * 0.05;
            const aeroBonus = gameState.upgrades.aero * 0.05;

            return {
                ...baseCar,
                topSpeed: Math.round(baseCar.topSpeed * (1 + engBonus + trbBonus * 0.7)),
                accel: Math.min(10, +(baseCar.accel * (1 + engBonus + trbBonus)).toFixed(1)),
                handling: Math.min(10, +(baseCar.handling * (1 + tireBonus + aeroBonus)).toFixed(1)),
                braking: Math.min(10, +(baseCar.braking * (1 + tireBonus)).toFixed(1))
            };
        }

        function getNearestTrackSample(pos) {
            if (!trackSamples.length) return { idx: 0, distSq: 0, sample: null };
            let bestIdx = 0;
            let bestDistSq = Infinity;
            // Coarse search then fine search for fast 3,600-sample lookup
            const step = 12;
            for (let i = 0; i < trackSamples.length; i += step) {
                const dx = pos.x - trackSamples[i].pt.x;
                const dz = pos.z - trackSamples[i].pt.z;
                const d2 = dx * dx + dz * dz;
                if (d2 < bestDistSq) {
                    bestDistSq = d2;
                    bestIdx = i;
                }
            }
            for (let offset = -step; offset <= step; offset++) {
                const idx = (bestIdx + offset + trackSamples.length) % trackSamples.length;
                const dx = pos.x - trackSamples[idx].pt.x;
                const dz = pos.z - trackSamples[idx].pt.z;
                const d2 = dx * dx + dz * dz;
                if (d2 < bestDistSq) {
                    bestDistSq = d2;
                    bestIdx = idx;
                }
            }
            return { idx: bestIdx, distSq: bestDistSq, sample: trackSamples[bestIdx] };
        }

        function clearAllVehicles() {
            if (playerVehicle && playerVehicle.obj) {
                scene.remove(playerVehicle.obj.mesh);
            }
            aiVehicles.forEach(ai => {
                if (ai.obj) scene.remove(ai.obj.mesh);
            });
            playerVehicle = null;
            aiVehicles = [];
        }

        function spawnRaceGrid() {
            clearAllVehicles();
            const baseCar = getSelectedCar();
            const upgradedPlayerCar = getUpgradedCarStats(baseCar);

            const totalAi = parseInt(gameSettings.aiCount, 10);
            const totalRacers = totalAi + 1;

            // Determine Player Starting Slot based on Difficulty (Medium = P10, Hard = P15)
            const desiredSlot = gameSettings.difficulty === 'HARD' ? 14 : 9;
            const playerSlotIdx = Math.min(desiredSlot, totalRacers - 1);

            const SAMPLE_COUNT = trackSamples.length;
            const gridSpacingSamples = 9; // Staggered 2-by-2 rolling start formation
            const leadSampleIdx = (SAMPLE_COUNT - 28 + SAMPLE_COUNT) % SAMPLE_COUNT;

            let aiCarCursor = 0;

            for (let gridPos = 0; gridPos < totalRacers; gridPos++) {
                const sIdx = (leadSampleIdx - gridPos * gridSpacingSamples + SAMPLE_COUNT) % SAMPLE_COUNT;
                const sample = trackSamples[sIdx];
                const lateralSide = gridPos % 2 === 0 ? -4.2 : 4.2;
                const spawnPos = sample.pt.clone().addScaledVector(sample.right, lateralSide);
                const heading = Math.atan2(-sample.tan.x, -sample.tan.z);

                if (gridPos === playerSlotIdx) {
                    // Spawn Player Vehicle (Blue Dot on Radar)
                    const obj = buildCarMesh(
                        upgradedPlayerCar,
                        gameState.customColors.body,
                        gameState.customColors.stripe,
                        gameState.customColors.rim
                    );
                    obj.mesh.position.copy(spawnPos);
                    obj.mesh.rotation.y = heading;
                    scene.add(obj.mesh);

                    playerVehicle = {
                        isPlayer: true,
                        name: 'YOU',
                        spec: upgradedPlayerCar,
                        obj,
                        pos: spawnPos.clone(),
                        vel: new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, 0),
                        heading,
                        speedMs: 0,
                        rpm: 1400,
                        gear: 2,
                        nos: 100,
                        steerAngle: 0,
                        slipAngle: 0,
                        lap: 1,
                        progressU: sample.u,
                        totalProgress: -((SAMPLE_COUNT - sIdx) / SAMPLE_COUNT),
                        finished: false,
                        finishTime: 0,
                        eliminated: false
                    };
                } else {
                    // Spawn AI Rival with Distinct Color & Famous F1 Driver Name
                    const aiSpec = CAR_DATABASE[(aiCarCursor * 3 + 1) % CAR_DATABASE.length];
                    const aiColor = DISTINCT_CAR_COLORS[gridPos % DISTINCT_CAR_COLORS.length];
                    const stripeColor = DISTINCT_CAR_COLORS[(gridPos + 7) % DISTINCT_CAR_COLORS.length];
                    const driverName = F1_DRIVER_NAMES[aiCarCursor % F1_DRIVER_NAMES.length];

                    const obj = buildCarMesh(aiSpec, aiColor, stripeColor, '#e2e8f0');
                    const nameSprite = createDriverNameSprite(driverName, aiColor);
                    obj.mesh.add(nameSprite);

                    obj.mesh.position.copy(spawnPos);
                    obj.mesh.rotation.y = heading;
                    scene.add(obj.mesh);

                    // Match AI top speed closely to player's upgraded top speed
                    const skillFactor = 0.96 + (1 - gridPos / Math.max(1, totalRacers)) * 0.07;
                    const matchedTopSpeedMs = (upgradedPlayerCar.topSpeed * 0.62) * skillFactor;

                    aiVehicles.push({
                        isPlayer: false,
                        name: driverName,
                        spec: aiSpec,
                        obj,
                        pos: spawnPos.clone(),
                        heading,
                        speedMs: 0,
                        maxSpeedMs: matchedTopSpeedMs,
                        laneOffset: lateralSide,
                        sampleIdx: sIdx,
                        lap: 1,
                        progressU: sample.u,
                        totalProgress: -((SAMPLE_COUNT - sIdx) / SAMPLE_COUNT),
                        finished: false,
                        finishTime: 0,
                        eliminated: false
                    });
                    aiCarCursor++;
                }
            }
        }

        function updatePlayerPhysics(dt, isRollingCountdown) {
            if (!playerVehicle) return;
            const v = playerVehicle;
            const spec = v.spec;

            // Weather grip modifier
            let weatherGrip = 1.0;
            if (gameSettings.weather === 'RAIN') weatherGrip = 0.84;
            else if (gameSettings.weather === 'STORM') weatherGrip = 0.76;
            else if (gameSettings.weather === 'SNOW') weatherGrip = 0.70;
            else if (gameSettings.weather === 'FOG') weatherGrip = 0.92;

            // High-speed terminal velocity in m/s (boosted for blistering sensation of speed)
            const maxSpeedMs = spec.topSpeed * 0.62;
            const forwardDir = new THREE.Vector3(-Math.sin(v.heading), 0, -Math.cos(v.heading));
            const rightDir = new THREE.Vector3(Math.cos(v.heading), 0, -Math.sin(v.heading));

            if (isRollingCountdown) {
                // Rolling Start: hold formation speed along the track
                const nearest = getNearestTrackSample(v.pos);
                const s = nearest.sample;
                const targetHeading = Math.atan2(-s.tan.x, -s.tan.z);
                let diff = targetHeading - v.heading;
                while (diff > Math.PI) diff -= Math.PI * 2;
                while (diff < -Math.PI) diff += Math.PI * 2;
                v.heading += diff * Math.min(1, dt * 6);

                const rollingSpeed = 32; // ~72 MPH rolling start pace
                v.speedMs += (rollingSpeed - v.speedMs) * Math.min(1, dt * 4);
                v.pos.addScaledVector(forwardDir, v.speedMs * dt);
                v.gear = 2;
                v.rpm = spec.maxRpm * 0.56;
                v.steerAngle = 0;
                v.slipAngle = 0;
            } else {
                // Active Player Driving Physics
                const throttleInput = controls.throttle;
                const brakeInput = controls.brake;
                const isNos = controls.nos && v.nos > 1 && throttleInput > 0.1;

                if (isNos) {
                    v.nos = Math.max(0, v.nos - dt * 24);
                } else {
                    v.nos = Math.min(100, v.nos + dt * 6.5);
                }
                v.obj.flames.forEach(f => { f.visible = isNos; });

                // Steering
                let steerTarget = 0;
                if (controls.steerLeft) steerTarget += 1;
                if (controls.steerRight) steerTarget -= 1;
                steerTarget *= gameSettings.steerSens;
                v.steerAngle += (steerTarget - v.steerAngle) * Math.min(1, dt * 11);

                // Acceleration & Braking
                const accelForce = (26 + spec.accel * 4.4) * (isNos ? 1.48 : 1.0) * weatherGrip;
                const brakeForce = 38 + spec.braking * 4.5;
                const effectiveMax = maxSpeedMs * (isNos ? 1.24 : 1.0);

                if (throttleInput > 0) {
                    const speedRatio = Math.max(0, v.speedMs / effectiveMax);
                    const torqueCurve = Math.max(0.18, 1 - Math.pow(speedRatio, 1.85));
                    v.speedMs += throttleInput * accelForce * torqueCurve * dt;
                }

                if (brakeInput > 0) {
                    if (v.speedMs > 1.5) {
                        v.speedMs -= brakeInput * brakeForce * dt;
                    } else {
                        v.speedMs -= brakeInput * 22 * dt; // Reverse
                    }
                }

                // Aerodynamic & Rolling Drag
                const drag = 0.0022 * v.speedMs * Math.abs(v.speedMs) + 0.18 * v.speedMs;
                v.speedMs -= drag * dt;
                v.speedMs = Math.max(-28, Math.min(effectiveMax, v.speedMs));

                // Cornering & Drift Dynamics
                const speedFactor = Math.min(1, Math.abs(v.speedMs) / 14);
                const highSpeedDamp = 1 / (1 + Math.abs(v.speedMs) * 0.0075);
                const gripTurnRate = (1.55 + spec.handling * 0.14) * weatherGrip * highSpeedDamp;
                const driftMult = controls.handbrake ? 1.45 : 1.0;
                const dirSign = v.speedMs >= -0.1 ? 1 : -1;

                v.heading += v.steerAngle * gripTurnRate * driftMult * speedFactor * dirSign * dt;

                // Lateral Slip / Drift Calculation
                const targetSlip = (controls.handbrake ? 0.48 : 0.14) * v.steerAngle * speedFactor;
                v.slipAngle += (targetSlip - v.slipAngle) * Math.min(1, dt * 7);

                const moveDir = forwardDir.clone().addScaledVector(rightDir, -v.slipAngle * 0.65).normalize();
                v.pos.addScaledVector(moveDir, v.speedMs * dt);

                // Automatic / Manual Gear & RPM Simulation
                const absSpeed = Math.abs(v.speedMs);
                if (v.speedMs < -0.5) {
                    v.gear = 'R';
                    v.rpm = Math.min(spec.maxRpm, 1500 + (absSpeed / 28) * (spec.maxRpm * 0.7));
                } else if (absSpeed < 1.0 && throttleInput === 0) {
                    v.gear = 'N';
                    v.rpm = 1100 + Math.sin(performance.now() * 0.02) * 60;
                } else {
                    const numGears = Math.max(1, spec.gears);
                    if (gameSettings.transmission === 'AUTO') {
                        const gearSpan = effectiveMax / numGears;
                        const idealGear = Math.min(numGears, Math.max(1, Math.floor(absSpeed / gearSpan) + 1));
                        if (idealGear > v.gear && typeof v.gear === 'number') {
                            audioEngine.playGearShift('UP');
                        } else if (idealGear < v.gear && typeof v.gear === 'number') {
                            audioEngine.playGearShift('DOWN');
                        }
                        v.gear = idealGear;
                    } else if (typeof v.gear !== 'number') {
                        v.gear = 1;
                    }

                    const gIdx = typeof v.gear === 'number' ? v.gear : 1;
                    const gearMinSpeed = ((gIdx - 1) / numGears) * effectiveMax * 0.85;
                    const gearMaxSpeed = (gIdx / numGears) * effectiveMax;
                    const gearRatio = Math.max(0.18, Math.min(1.02, (absSpeed - gearMinSpeed) / Math.max(8, gearMaxSpeed - gearMinSpeed)));
                    v.rpm = 1400 + gearRatio * (spec.maxRpm - 1400);
                }

                // Drift Scoring
                const slipMag = Math.abs(v.slipAngle);
                if (slipMag > 0.22 && absSpeed > 18) {
                    const pts = Math.round(slipMag * absSpeed * dt * 18);
                    gameState.currentDriftPoints += pts;
                    gameState.currentDriftCombo = Math.min(5, 1 + Math.floor(gameState.currentDriftPoints / 600));
                } else if (gameState.currentDriftPoints > 0) {
                    gameState.driftScore += gameState.currentDriftPoints * gameState.currentDriftCombo;
                    gameState.currentDriftPoints = 0;
                    gameState.currentDriftCombo = 1;
                }
            }

            // Track Boundary Soft Guardrail Collision
            const nearest = getNearestTrackSample(v.pos);
            if (nearest.sample) {
                const toCar = v.pos.clone().sub(nearest.sample.pt);
                const lateralDist = toCar.dot(nearest.sample.right);
                const maxLateral = currentTrackData.roadWidth * 0.5 + 1.4;

                if (Math.abs(lateralDist) > maxLateral) {
                    const sign = Math.sign(lateralDist);
                    v.pos.copy(nearest.sample.pt).addScaledVector(nearest.sample.right, sign * maxLateral);
                    if (Math.abs(v.speedMs) > 15) {
                        audioEngine.playCollision(Math.abs(v.speedMs) / 70);
                        v.speedMs *= 0.84;
                    }
                }

                // Lap & Progress Tracking
                const prevU = v.progressU;
                const newU = nearest.sample.u;
                let deltaU = newU - prevU;
                if (deltaU < -0.5) deltaU += 1.0; // Crossed start/finish line forward
                if (deltaU > 0.5) deltaU -= 1.0;  // Crossed backward

                v.totalProgress += deltaU;
                v.progressU = newU;

                const computedLap = Math.max(1, Math.floor(v.totalProgress) + 1);
                if (computedLap > v.lap && !isRollingCountdown) {
                    const lapDuration = gameState.raceTime - gameState.currentLapStartTime;
                    if (lapDuration > 8 && lapDuration < gameState.bestLapTime) {
                        gameState.bestLapTime = lapDuration;
                    }
                    gameState.currentLapStartTime = gameState.raceTime;
                    v.lap = computedLap;
                    onPlayerLapCompleted(v.lap);
                }

                // Wrong-Way Detection
                const dotForward = forwardDir.dot(nearest.sample.tan);
                const wrongWayEl = document.getElementById('wrong-way-alert');
                if (wrongWayEl) {
                    wrongWayEl.style.display = (!isRollingCountdown && dotForward < -0.35 && v.speedMs > 5) ? 'block' : 'none';
                }
            }

            // Update 3D Mesh Transform & Wheel Rotation
            v.obj.mesh.position.copy(v.pos);
            v.obj.mesh.rotation.y = v.heading + v.slipAngle * 0.35;
            v.obj.steeringWheelMesh.rotation.z = v.steerAngle * 0.85;

            v.obj.wheels.forEach((w, idx) => {
                w.children[0].rotation.x -= v.speedMs * dt * 2.5;
                w.children[1].rotation.x -= v.speedMs * dt * 2.5;
                if (idx < 2) {
                    w.rotation.y = v.steerAngle * 0.42;
                }
            });

            // Update Engine Sound
            const rpmNorm = v.rpm / spec.maxRpm;
            const slipNorm = Math.abs(v.slipAngle) * 1.6;
            audioEngine.update(rpmNorm, controls.throttle, slipNorm, controls.nos && v.nos > 1, true, Math.abs(v.speedMs));
        }

        function updateAiVehicles(dt, isRollingCountdown) {
            const SAMPLE_COUNT = trackSamples.length;
            aiVehicles.forEach((ai, idx) => {
                if (ai.eliminated) return;

                const lookAheadIdx = (ai.sampleIdx + 14) % SAMPLE_COUNT;
                const targetSample = trackSamples[lookAheadIdx];
                const targetPt = targetSample.pt.clone().addScaledVector(targetSample.right, ai.laneOffset);

                const toTarget = targetPt.clone().sub(ai.pos);
                const targetHeading = Math.atan2(-toTarget.x, -toTarget.z);
                let diff = targetHeading - ai.heading;
                while (diff > Math.PI) diff -= Math.PI * 2;
                while (diff < -Math.PI) diff += Math.PI * 2;
                ai.heading += diff * Math.min(1, dt * 5.5);

                // Rubber-banding & Rolling Start Speed Control
                let targetSpeed = ai.maxSpeedMs;
                if (isRollingCountdown) {
                    targetSpeed = 32;
                } else if (playerVehicle) {
                    const progressGap = ai.totalProgress - playerVehicle.totalProgress;
                    if (progressGap > 0.08) targetSpeed *= 0.91;
                    else if (progressGap < -0.08) targetSpeed *= 1.06;
                }

                ai.speedMs += (targetSpeed - ai.speedMs) * Math.min(1, dt * 2.4);
                const forward = new THREE.Vector3(-Math.sin(ai.heading), 0, -Math.cos(ai.heading));
                ai.pos.addScaledVector(forward, ai.speedMs * dt);

                const nearest = getNearestTrackSample(ai.pos);
                if (nearest.sample) {
                    let deltaU = nearest.sample.u - ai.progressU;
                    if (deltaU < -0.5) deltaU += 1.0;
                    if (deltaU > 0.5) deltaU -= 1.0;
                    ai.totalProgress += deltaU;
                    ai.progressU = nearest.sample.u;
                    ai.sampleIdx = nearest.idx;
                    ai.lap = Math.max(1, Math.floor(ai.totalProgress) + 1);
                }

                ai.obj.mesh.position.copy(ai.pos);
                ai.obj.mesh.rotation.y = ai.heading;
                ai.obj.wheels.forEach(w => {
                    w.children[0].rotation.x -= ai.speedMs * dt * 2.5;
                    w.children[1].rotation.x -= ai.speedMs * dt * 2.5;
                });
            });
        }

        function getRaceStandings() {
            const all = [];
            if (playerVehicle) all.push(playerVehicle);
            aiVehicles.forEach(ai => { if (!ai.eliminated) all.push(ai); });
            all.sort((a, b) => b.totalProgress - a.totalProgress);
            return all;
        }

        function onPlayerLapCompleted(newLap) {
            const mode = gameState.gameMode;
            if (mode === 'RACE') {
                if (newLap > 3) {
                    finishRace();
                } else {
                    showToast(`🏁 LAP ${newLap} / 3`);
                }
            } else if (mode === 'TIMETRIAL') {
                if (newLap > 2) {
                    finishRace();
                } else {
                    showToast(`⏱️ TIMED LAP ${newLap} / 2`);
                }
            } else if (mode === 'DRIFT') {
                if (newLap > 2 || gameState.driftScore >= 15000) {
                    finishRace();
                } else {
                    showToast(`🔥 LAP ${newLap} / 2 • DRIFT PTS: ${gameState.driftScore.toLocaleString()}`);
                }
            } else if (mode === 'ELIMINATION') {
                const standings = getRaceStandings();
                if (standings.length <= 2) {
                    finishRace();
                    return;
                }
                const lastPlace = standings[standings.length - 1];
                if (lastPlace.isPlayer) {
                    finishRace(true);
                } else {
                    lastPlace.eliminated = true;
                    lastPlace.obj.mesh.visible = false;
                    showToast(`💀 ${lastPlace.name} ELIMINATED!`);
                }
            } else {
                showToast(`🛣️ LAP ${newLap} COMPLETE`);
            }
        }

        function finishRace(wasEliminated = false) {
            gameState.screen = 'FINISHED';
            audioEngine.update(0.15, 0, 0, false, false, 0);

            const standings = getRaceStandings();
            const playerRank = standings.findIndex(r => r.isPlayer) + 1;
            const prizeTable = [50000, 30000, 20000, 12000, 8000];
            const prize = wasEliminated ? 2500 : (prizeTable[playerRank - 1] || 5000);
            gameState.credits += prize;
            document.getElementById('ui-credits').textContent = '$' + gameState.credits.toLocaleString();

            const resTitle = document.getElementById('res-title');
            const resSub = document.getElementById('res-subtitle');
            if (wasEliminated) {
                resSub.textContent = 'ELIMINATED';
                resTitle.textContent = 'KNOCKED OUT!';
            } else if (gameState.gameMode === 'DRIFT') {
                resSub.textContent = 'DRIFT CHALLENGE COMPLETE';
                resTitle.textContent = `${gameState.driftScore.toLocaleString()} DRIFT PTS`;
            } else {
                resSub.textContent = `${currentTrackData.name.toUpperCase()} • COMPLETE`;
                const suffix = playerRank === 1 ? 'ST' : (playerRank === 2 ? 'ND' : (playerRank === 3 ? 'RD' : 'TH'));
                resTitle.textContent = `${playerRank}${suffix} PLACE FINISH!`;
            }

            document.getElementById('res-best-lap').textContent =
                gameState.bestLapTime === Infinity ? formatRaceTime(gameState.raceTime) : formatRaceTime(gameState.bestLapTime);
            document.getElementById('res-prize').textContent = `+$${prize.toLocaleString()}`;

            const tbody = document.getElementById('res-standings-body');
            tbody.innerHTML = '';
            standings.slice(0, 10).forEach((racer, idx) => {
                const tr = document.createElement('tr');
                if (racer.isPlayer) tr.className = 'player-row';
                const gapMeters = Math.max(0, Math.round((standings[0].totalProgress - racer.totalProgress) * trackTotalLength));
                tr.innerHTML = `
                    <td><b>P${idx + 1}</b></td>
                    <td>${racer.name}</td>
                    <td>${racer.spec.name}</td>
                    <td>${idx === 0 ? 'LEADER' : '+' + gapMeters + 'm'}</td>
                `;
                tbody.appendChild(tr);
            });

            document.getElementById('results-modal-backdrop').classList.add('open');
        }

        /* ============================================================================
           9. CAMERA CONTROLLER (1ST-PERSON COCKPIT, HOOD, 3RD-PERSON CHASE)
           ============================================================================ */
        const smoothCamPos = new THREE.Vector3();
        const smoothCamLook = new THREE.Vector3();

        function updateCamera(dt) {
            if (gameState.screen === 'MENU') {
                showcaseYaw += dt * 0.25;
                if (showcaseCarObj) {
                    showcaseCarObj.mesh.rotation.y = showcaseYaw;
                }
                camera.position.set(4.8, 2.2, 5.4);
                camera.lookAt(0, 0.75, 0);
                sunLight.position.set(15, 25, 15);
                sunLight.target.position.set(0, 0, 0);
                return;
            }

            if (!playerVehicle) return;
            const v = playerVehicle;
            const forward = new THREE.Vector3(-Math.sin(v.heading), 0, -Math.cos(v.heading));
            const right = new THREE.Vector3(Math.cos(v.heading), 0, -Math.sin(v.heading));

            // Keep shadow frustum centered on player car
            sunLight.position.set(v.pos.x + 220, 480, v.pos.z + 180);
            sunLight.target.position.copy(v.pos);

            const isOpenWheel = v.spec.shape === 'f1' || v.spec.shape === 'formula_e';
            const speedFovBoost = Math.min(22, (Math.abs(v.speedMs) / 130) * 22);
            camera.fov += ((65 + speedFovBoost) - camera.fov) * Math.min(1, dt * 6);
            camera.updateProjectionMatrix();

            if (gameSettings.cameraMode === 'FIRST') {
                // 1st-Person Cockpit Driver Eye Position
                const seatX = isOpenWheel ? 0 : -0.34;
                const eyePos = v.pos.clone()
                    .addScaledVector(right, seatX)
                    .add(new THREE.Vector3(0, isOpenWheel ? 0.96 : 1.08, 0))
                    .addScaledVector(forward, -0.05);
                const lookTarget = eyePos.clone().addScaledVector(forward, 32).add(new THREE.Vector3(0, -0.8, 0));

                camera.position.copy(eyePos);
                camera.lookAt(lookTarget);
            } else if (gameSettings.cameraMode === 'HOOD') {
                const hoodPos = v.pos.clone()
                    .add(new THREE.Vector3(0, 1.05, 0))
                    .addScaledVector(forward, 0.85);
                const lookTarget = hoodPos.clone().addScaledVector(forward, 35);
                camera.position.copy(hoodPos);
                camera.lookAt(lookTarget);
            } else {
                // 3rd-Person Dynamic Chase Cam
                const distBack = 6.6 + Math.min(2.2, Math.abs(v.speedMs) * 0.018);
                const desiredPos = v.pos.clone()
                    .addScaledVector(forward, -distBack)
                    .add(new THREE.Vector3(0, 2.35, 0));
                const desiredLook = v.pos.clone()
                    .addScaledVector(forward, 12)
                    .add(new THREE.Vector3(0, 1.05, 0));

                smoothCamPos.lerp(desiredPos, Math.min(1, dt * 11));
                smoothCamLook.lerp(desiredLook, Math.min(1, dt * 14));
                camera.position.copy(smoothCamPos);
                camera.lookAt(smoothCamLook);
            }
        }

        /* ============================================================================
           10. SCALABLE HUD RENDERER (ANALOG TACHO, LIVE RADAR MINI-MAP & SPEED FX)
           ============================================================================ */
        const tachoCanvas = document.getElementById('tacho-canvas');
        const tachoCtx = tachoCanvas.getContext('2d');
        const minimapCanvas = document.getElementById('minimap-canvas');
        const minimapCtx = minimapCanvas.getContext('2d');
        const speedLinesCanvas = document.getElementById('speed-lines-canvas');
        const speedLinesCtx = speedLinesCanvas.getContext('2d');

        function formatRaceTime(sec) {
            const mins = Math.floor(sec / 60);
            const rem = sec % 60;
            const s = Math.floor(rem);
            const ms = Math.floor((rem - s) * 100);
            return `${String(mins).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(s).padStart(2, '0')}.${String(ms).padStart(2, '0')}`;
        }

        function drawTachometer(rpmRatio) {
            const w = tachoCanvas.width;
            const h = tachoCanvas.height;
            const cx = w / 2;
            const cy = h / 2;
            const radius = 92;

            tachoCtx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);

            const startAngle = Math.PI * 0.75;
            const endAngle = Math.PI * 2.25;
            const totalSweep = endAngle - startAngle;

            // Background Arc
            tachoCtx.beginPath();
            tachoCtx.arc(cx, cy, radius, startAngle, endAngle);
            tachoCtx.lineWidth = 12;
            tachoCtx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12)';
            tachoCtx.lineCap = 'round';
            tachoCtx.stroke();

            // Active RPM Arc
            const clamped = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, rpmRatio));
            const activeEnd = startAngle + totalSweep * clamped;
            const grad = tachoCtx.createLinearGradient(0, h, w, 0);
            grad.addColorStop(0, '#00e5ff');
            grad.addColorStop(0.72, '#30d158');
            grad.addColorStop(0.9, '#ff3b30');

            tachoCtx.beginPath();
            tachoCtx.arc(cx, cy, radius, startAngle, activeEnd);
            tachoCtx.lineWidth = 12;
            tachoCtx.strokeStyle = grad;
            tachoCtx.lineCap = 'round';
            tachoCtx.stroke();

            // Tick Marks
            for (let i = 0; i <= 10; i++) {
                const a = startAngle + (i / 10) * totalSweep;
                const inner = radius - 18;
                const outer = radius - 8;
                tachoCtx.beginPath();
                tachoCtx.moveTo(cx + Math.cos(a) * inner, cy + Math.sin(a) * inner);
                tachoCtx.lineTo(cx + Math.cos(a) * outer, cy + Math.sin(a) * outer);
                tachoCtx.lineWidth = i >= 8 ? 3 : 2;
                tachoCtx.strokeStyle = i >= 8 ? '#ff3b30' : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.6)';
                tachoCtx.stroke();
            }
        }

        function drawMiniMap() {
            if (!trackSamples.length || !playerVehicle) return;
            const w = minimapCanvas.width;
            const h = minimapCanvas.height;
            minimapCtx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);

            // Compute Track Bounding Box
            let minX = Infinity, maxX = -Infinity, minZ = Infinity, maxZ = -Infinity;
            for (let i = 0; i < trackSamples.length; i += 20) {
                const p = trackSamples[i].pt;
                if (p.x < minX) minX = p.x;
                if (p.x > maxX) maxX = p.x;
                if (p.z < minZ) minZ = p.z;
                if (p.z > maxZ) maxZ = p.z;
            }
            const spanX = Math.max(1, maxX - minX);
            const spanZ = Math.max(1, maxZ - minZ);
            const scale = (w - 26) / Math.max(spanX, spanZ);
            const offsetX = (w - spanX * scale) * 0.5;
            const offsetZ = (h - spanZ * scale) * 0.5;

            const toMapX = (wx) => offsetX + (wx - minX) * scale;
            const toMapY = (wz) => offsetZ + (wz - minZ) * scale;

            // Draw Track Loop
            minimapCtx.beginPath();
            for (let i = 0; i < trackSamples.length; i += 15) {
                const p = trackSamples[i].pt;
                const mx = toMapX(p.x);
                const my = toMapY(p.z);
                if (i === 0) minimapCtx.moveTo(mx, my);
                else minimapCtx.lineTo(mx, my);
            }
            minimapCtx.closePath();
            minimapCtx.lineWidth = 5;
            minimapCtx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.35)';
            minimapCtx.stroke();

            // Draw All AI Opponents as RED DOTS
            aiVehicles.forEach(ai => {
                if (ai.eliminated) return;
                minimapCtx.beginPath();
                minimapCtx.arc(toMapX(ai.pos.x), toMapY(ai.pos.z), 3.4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                minimapCtx.fillStyle = '#ff2d55';
                minimapCtx.fill();
            });

            // Draw Player as Bright BLUE DOT with white ring
            const px = toMapX(playerVehicle.pos.x);
            const py = toMapY(playerVehicle.pos.z);
            minimapCtx.beginPath();
            minimapCtx.arc(px, py, 5.2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            minimapCtx.fillStyle = '#00a8ff';
            minimapCtx.fill();
            minimapCtx.lineWidth = 1.8;
            minimapCtx.strokeStyle = '#ffffff';
            minimapCtx.stroke();
        }

        function updateHudDisplay() {
            if (!playerVehicle || gameState.screen === 'MENU') return;
            const v = playerVehicle;

            // Speed Conversion
            const mph = Math.round(Math.abs(v.speedMs) * 1.61);
            const displaySpeed = gameSettings.units === 'KMH' ? Math.round(mph * 1.609) : mph;
            document.getElementById('hud-speed-val').textContent = displaySpeed;
            document.getElementById('hud-speed-unit').textContent = gameSettings.units;
            document.getElementById('hud-gear-val').textContent = v.gear;

            // Standings & Lap
            const standings = getRaceStandings();
            const pos = standings.findIndex(r => r.isPlayer) + 1;
            document.getElementById('hud-position').textContent = `${pos}/${standings.length}`;
            const maxLaps = gameState.gameMode === 'RACE' ? 3 : (gameState.gameMode === 'TIMETRIAL' || gameState.gameMode === 'DRIFT' ? 2 : '∞');
            document.getElementById('hud-lap').textContent = `${v.lap}/${maxLaps}`;
            document.getElementById('hud-lap-time').textContent = formatRaceTime(gameState.raceTime);

            // Drift Meter
            const driftMetric = document.getElementById('hud-drift-metric');
            const driftPopup = document.getElementById('drift-score-popup');
            if (gameState.gameMode === 'DRIFT' || gameState.driftScore > 0 || gameState.currentDriftPoints > 0) {
                driftMetric.style.display = 'flex';
                document.getElementById('hud-drift-total').textContent = (gameState.driftScore + gameState.currentDriftPoints).toLocaleString();
            }
            if (gameState.currentDriftPoints > 50) {
                driftPopup.style.display = 'block';
                driftPopup.textContent = `DRIFT +${gameState.currentDriftPoints.toLocaleString()} (x${gameState.currentDriftCombo})`;
            } else {
                driftPopup.style.display = 'none';
            }

            // Nitrous Bar
            const nosPct = Math.round(v.nos);
            document.getElementById('hud-nos-pct').textContent = `${nosPct}%`;
            document.getElementById('hud-nos-fill').style.width = `${nosPct}%`;

            // Analog Tachometer & Radar Mini-map
            drawTachometer(v.rpm / v.spec.maxRpm);
            drawMiniMap();

            // High-Speed Radial Motion Lines above 180 MPH
            if (mph > 175) {
                speedLinesCanvas.style.opacity = Math.min(0.65, (mph - 175) / 140).toFixed(2);
                speedLinesCanvas.width = window.innerWidth;
                speedLinesCanvas.height = window.innerHeight;
                const cx = speedLinesCanvas.width / 2;
                const cy = speedLinesCanvas.height / 2;
                speedLinesCtx.clearRect(0, 0, speedLinesCanvas.width, speedLinesCanvas.height);
                speedLinesCtx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(224, 242, 254, 0.45)';
                speedLinesCtx.lineWidth = 2;
                for (let i = 0; i < 28; i++) {
                    const ang = (i / 28) * Math.PI * 2 + performance.now() * 0.005;
                    const r1 = Math.min(cx, cy) * (0.65 + Math.random() * 0.15);
                    const r2 = Math.max(cx, cy) * 1.25;
                    speedLinesCtx.beginPath();
                    speedLinesCtx.moveTo(cx + Math.cos(ang) * r1, cy + Math.sin(ang) * r1);
                    speedLinesCtx.lineTo(cx + Math.cos(ang) * r2, cy + Math.sin(ang) * r2);
                    speedLinesCtx.stroke();
                }
            } else {
                speedLinesCanvas.style.opacity = '0';
            }
        }

        /* ============================================================================
           11. UI BUILDERS, GARAGE MENUS, SETTINGS & INPUT BINDINGS
           ============================================================================ */
        function showToast(msg) {
            const containerEl = document.getElementById('toast-container');
            const div = document.createElement('div');
            div.className = 'toast-msg';
            div.textContent = msg;
            containerEl.appendChild(div);
            setTimeout(() => {
                div.style.opacity = '0';
                setTimeout(() => div.remove(), 250);
            }, 2600);
        }

        function renderCarList(filterClass = 'ALL') {
            const listEl = document.getElementById('car-selection-list');
            listEl.innerHTML = '';

            const filtered = filterClass === 'ALL'
                ? CAR_DATABASE
                : CAR_DATABASE.filter(c => c.class === filterClass);

            filtered.forEach(car => {
                const card = document.createElement('div');
                card.className = 'car-item-card' + (car.id === gameState.selectedCarId ? ' selected' : '');
                card.innerHTML = `
                    <div class="car-item-info">
                        <h4>${car.name}</h4>
                        <div class="car-item-meta">
                            <span class="engine-badge">${car.engineType.replace(/_/g, ' ')}</span>
                            <span>${car.drivetrain}</span>
                            <span>• ${car.topSpeed} MPH</span>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    <div style="width:18px; height:18px; border-radius:50%; background:${car.color}; border:2px solid #fff;"></div>
                `;
                card.addEventListener('click', () => {
                    gameState.selectedCarId = car.id;
                    gameState.customColors.body = car.color;
                    gameState.customColors.stripe = car.stripe;
                    audioEngine.configureForCar(car);
                    renderCarList(filterClass);
                    updateCarSpecsPanel();
                    rebuildShowcaseCar();
                });
                listEl.appendChild(card);
            });
        }

        function updateCarSpecsPanel() {
            const baseCar = getSelectedCar();
            const car = getUpgradedCarStats(baseCar);
            document.getElementById('spec-car-class').textContent = car.class;
            document.getElementById('spec-car-name').textContent = car.name;
            document.getElementById('spec-car-drivetrain').textContent = car.drivetrain;
            document.getElementById('spec-car-engine-desc').textContent = car.desc;

            document.getElementById('stat-val-speed').textContent = `${car.topSpeed} MPH`;
            document.getElementById('stat-bar-speed').style.width = `${Math.min(100, (car.topSpeed / 295) * 100)}%`;

            document.getElementById('stat-val-accel').textContent = `${car.accel} / 10`;
            document.getElementById('stat-bar-accel').style.width = `${car.accel * 10}%`;

            document.getElementById('stat-val-handling').textContent = `${car.handling} / 10`;
            document.getElementById('stat-bar-handling').style.width = `${car.handling * 10}%`;

            document.getElementById('stat-val-braking').textContent = `${car.braking} / 10`;
            document.getElementById('stat-bar-braking').style.width = `${car.braking * 10}%`;
        }

        function renderTrackList() {
            const listEl = document.getElementById('track-selection-list');
            listEl.innerHTML = '';

            TRACK_DATABASE.forEach(track => {
                const card = document.createElement('div');
                card.className = 'track-card' + (track.id === gameState.selectedTrackId ? ' selected' : '');
                card.innerHTML = `
                    <div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center;">
                        <h4 style="font-size:0.95rem; font-weight:800;">${track.name}</h4>
                        <span class="engine-badge">${track.theme}</span>
                    </div>
                    <div style="font-size:0.75rem; color:var(--text-muted); margin-top:4px;">${track.location}</div>
                `;
                card.addEventListener('click', () => {
                    gameState.selectedTrackId = track.id;
                    document.getElementById('footer-track-name').textContent = track.name;
                    renderTrackList();
                });
                listEl.appendChild(card);
            });
        }

        function renderPaintAndUpgrades() {
            const palette = ['#ef4444', '#2563eb', '#16a34a', '#facc15', '#f97316', '#7c3aed', '#06b6d4', '#f8fafc', '#18181b', '#ec4899'];

            const buildSwatches = (containerId, key) => {
                const el = document.getElementById(containerId);
                el.innerHTML = '';
                palette.forEach(hex => {
                    const sw = document.createElement('div');
                    sw.className = 'swatch' + (gameState.customColors[key] === hex ? ' active' : '');
                    sw.style.backgroundColor = hex;
                    sw.addEventListener('click', () => {
                        gameState.customColors[key] = hex;
                        buildSwatches(containerId, key);
                        rebuildShowcaseCar();
                    });
                    el.appendChild(sw);
                });
            };

            buildSwatches('body-color-swatches', 'body');
            buildSwatches('stripe-color-swatches', 'stripe');
            buildSwatches('rim-color-swatches', 'rim');

            const upgContainer = document.getElementById('upgrades-container');
            upgContainer.innerHTML = '';
            const upgradeDefs = [
                { key: 'engine', label: '🔥 Forged Engine Internals', cost: 12000 },
                { key: 'turbo', label: '🌀 Twin-Scroll Turbo / Blower', cost: 15000 },
                { key: 'tires', label: '🛞 Pirelli P-Zero Slick Tires', cost: 9000 },
                { key: 'aero', label: '🪽 Carbon Downforce Aero Kit', cost: 11000 }
            ];

            upgradeDefs.forEach(u => {
                const lvl = gameState.upgrades[u.key];
                const row = document.createElement('div');
                row.className = 'upgrade-row';
                row.innerHTML = `
                    <div>
                        <div style="font-weight:700; font-size:0.84rem;">${u.label}</div>
                        <div style="font-size:0.72rem; color:var(--accent);">Stage ${lvl} / 3</div>
                    </div>
                    <button class="btn btn-gold" style="padding:6px 12px; font-size:0.76rem;" ${lvl >= 3 ? 'disabled' : ''}>
                        ${lvl >= 3 ? 'MAXED' : '$' + u.cost.toLocaleString()}
                    </button>
                `;
                row.querySelector('button').addEventListener('click', () => {
                    if (lvl < 3 && gameState.credits >= u.cost) {
                        gameState.credits -= u.cost;
                        gameState.upgrades[u.key]++;
                        document.getElementById('ui-credits').textContent = '$' + gameState.credits.toLocaleString();
                        renderPaintAndUpgrades();
                        updateCarSpecsPanel();
                        showToast(`Upgraded ${u.label} to Stage ${gameState.upgrades[u.key]}!`);
                    } else if (gameState.credits < u.cost) {
                        showToast('Not enough credits! Win races to earn more.');
                    }
                });
                upgContainer.appendChild(row);
            });
        }

        function startRaceSession() {
            audioEngine.init();
            const track = TRACK_DATABASE.find(t => t.id === gameState.selectedTrackId) || TRACK_DATABASE[0];

            showcaseGroup.visible = false;
            trackWorldGroup.visible = true;
            buildTrackEnvironment(track);
            spawnRaceGrid();

            audioEngine.configureForCar(getSelectedCar());

            // Reset Race Timers & State
            gameState.screen = 'COUNTDOWN';
            gameState.raceTime = 0;
            gameState.currentLapStartTime = 0;
            gameState.bestLapTime = Infinity;
            gameState.driftScore = 0;
            gameState.currentDriftPoints = 0;
            gameState.countdownTimer = 3.4;
            gameState.goBannerTimer = 0;

            document.getElementById('main-menu-overlay').classList.add('hidden');
            document.getElementById('results-modal-backdrop').classList.remove('open');
            document.getElementById('racing-hud-wrapper').classList.add('active');
            document.getElementById('hud-car-name').textContent = getSelectedCar().name;
            document.getElementById('btn-quit-to-menu').style.display = 'inline-flex';
            document.getElementById('btn-restart-race').style.display = 'inline-flex';

            const banner = document.getElementById('countdown-banner');
            banner.style.display = 'block';
            banner.style.color = '#ffffff';
            banner.textContent = '3';
            audioEngine.playBeep(440, 0.2);

            if (playerVehicle) {
                smoothCamPos.copy(playerVehicle.pos).add(new THREE.Vector3(0, 3, 7));
                smoothCamLook.copy(playerVehicle.pos);
            }
        }

        function returnToGarageMenu() {
            gameState.screen = 'MENU';
            audioEngine.update(0.15, 0, 0, false, false, 0);
            clearAllVehicles();
            trackWorldGroup.visible = false;
            showcaseGroup.visible = true;
            rebuildShowcaseCar();

            scene.background = new THREE.Color(0x0b101d);
            scene.fog = new THREE.FogExp2(0x0b101d, 0.015);

            document.getElementById('racing-hud-wrapper').classList.remove('active');
            document.getElementById('results-modal-backdrop').classList.remove('open');
            document.getElementById('settings-modal-backdrop').classList.remove('open');
            document.getElementById('main-menu-overlay').classList.remove('hidden');
            document.getElementById('btn-quit-to-menu').style.display = 'none';
            document.getElementById('btn-restart-race').style.display = 'none';
        }

            document.getElementById('lbl-steer-sens').textContent = gameSettings.steerSens.toFixed(1) + 'x';
        });
        document.getElementById('set-tcs').addEventListener('change', (e) => {
            gameSettings.tcs = e.target.checked;
        });

        // Interactive In-Game HUD Buttons
        function cycleCameraMode() {
            const modes = ['THIRD', 'FIRST', 'HOOD'];
            const next = modes[(modes.indexOf(gameSettings.cameraMode) + 1) % modes.length];
            gameSettings.cameraMode = next;
            document.getElementById('set-camera').value = next;
            document.getElementById('quick-camera-select').value = next;
            document.getElementById('hud-btn-camera').textContent = `🎥 CAM: ${next}`;
            applyWeatherEnvironment(gameSettings.weather);
            showToast(`Camera: ${next === 'FIRST' ? '1st-Person Cockpit' : (next === 'HOOD' ? 'Hood Cam' : '3rd-Person Chase')}`);
        }

        function toggleHeadlights() {
            gameState.headlightsOn = !gameState.headlightsOn;
            const btn = document.getElementById('hud-btn-lights');
            btn.classList.toggle('active-state', gameState.headlightsOn);
            if (playerVehicle) {
                playerVehicle.obj.spotLights.forEach(s => { s.visible = gameState.headlightsOn; });
                playerVehicle.obj.headLightMat.emissiveIntensity = gameState.headlightsOn ? 2.2 : 0.0;
            }
        }

        function resetPlayerOnTrack() {
            if (!playerVehicle || !trackSamples.length) return;
            const nearest = getNearestTrackSample(playerVehicle.pos);
            if (nearest.sample) {
                playerVehicle.pos.copy(nearest.sample.pt);
                playerVehicle.heading = Math.atan2(-nearest.sample.tan.x, -nearest.sample.tan.z);
                playerVehicle.speedMs = 0;
                playerVehicle.slipAngle = 0;
                showToast('Car reset onto track');
            }
        }

        document.getElementById('hud-btn-camera').addEventListener('click', cycleCameraMode);
        document.getElementById('hud-btn-lights').addEventListener('click', toggleHeadlights);
        document.getElementById('hud-btn-horn').addEventListener('click', () => audioEngine.playHorn());
        document.getElementById('hud-btn-reset').addEventListener('click', resetPlayerOnTrack);
        document.getElementById('hud-btn-weather').addEventListener('click', () => {
            const list = ['CLEAR', 'SUNSET', 'OVERCAST', 'RAIN', 'STORM', 'FOG', 'SNOW'];
            const next = list[(list.indexOf(gameSettings.weather) + 1) % list.length];
            document.getElementById('set-weather').value = next;
            document.getElementById('quick-weather-select').value = next;
            applyWeatherEnvironment(next);
            showToast(`Weather changed to ${next}`);
        });
        document.getElementById('hud-btn-mute').addEventListener('click', () => {
            audioEngine.isMuted = !audioEngine.isMuted;
            audioEngine.updateVolumes();
            document.getElementById('hud-btn-mute').textContent = audioEngine.isMuted ? '🔇 MUTED' : '🔊 AUDIO';
        });
        document.getElementById('hud-speed-unit').addEventListener('click', () => {
            gameSettings.units = gameSettings.units === 'MPH' ? 'KMH' : 'MPH';
            document.getElementById('set-units').value = gameSettings.units;
        });
        document.getElementById('hud-btn-gear-up').addEventListener('click', () => {
            if (!playerVehicle) return;
            gameSettings.transmission = 'MANUAL';
            document.getElementById('set-transmission').value = 'MANUAL';
            const g = typeof playerVehicle.gear === 'number' ? playerVehicle.gear : 1;
            if (g < playerVehicle.spec.gears) {
                playerVehicle.gear = g + 1;
                audioEngine.playGearShift('UP');
            }
        });
        document.getElementById('hud-btn-gear-down').addEventListener('click', () => {
            if (!playerVehicle) return;
            gameSettings.transmission = 'MANUAL';
            document.getElementById('set-transmission').value = 'MANUAL';
            const g = typeof playerVehicle.gear === 'number' ? playerVehicle.gear : 1;
            if (g > 1) {
                playerVehicle.gear = g - 1;
                audioEngine.playGearShift('DOWN');
            }
        });

        // Touch & Mouse On-Screen Pedals
        const bindHoldBtn = (id, onDown, onUp) => {
            const el = document.getElementById(id);
            const start = (e) => { e.preventDefault(); audioEngine.init(); el.classList.add('pressed'); onDown(); };
            const end = (e) => { e.preventDefault(); el.classList.remove('pressed'); onUp(); };
            el.addEventListener('mousedown', start);
            el.addEventListener('mouseup', end);
            el.addEventListener('mouseleave', end);
            el.addEventListener('touchstart', start, { passive: false });
            el.addEventListener('touchend', end, { passive: false });
        };

        bindHoldBtn('touch-left', () => { controls.steerLeft = true; }, () => { controls.steerLeft = false; });
        bindHoldBtn('touch-right', () => { controls.steerRight = true; }, () => { controls.steerRight = false; });
        bindHoldBtn('touch-gas', () => { controls.throttle = 1; }, () => { controls.throttle = 0; });
        bindHoldBtn('touch-brake', () => { controls.brake = 1; }, () => { controls.brake = 0; });
        bindHoldBtn('touch-handbrake', () => { controls.handbrake = true; }, () => { controls.handbrake = false; });
        bindHoldBtn('hud-btn-nos', () => { controls.nos = true; }, () => { controls.nos = false; });

        // Keyboard Listeners
        window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
            if (e.code === 'ArrowUp' || e.code === 'KeyW') controls.throttle = 1;
            if (e.code === 'ArrowDown' || e.code === 'KeyS') controls.brake = 1;
            if (e.code === 'ArrowLeft' || e.code === 'KeyA') controls.steerLeft = true;
            if (e.code === 'ArrowRight' || e.code === 'KeyD') controls.steerRight = true;
            if (e.code === 'Space') controls.handbrake = true;
            if (e.code === 'ShiftLeft' || e.code === 'ShiftRight') controls.nos = true;

            if (!e.repeat) {
                if (e.code === 'KeyC') cycleCameraMode();
                if (e.code === 'KeyL') toggleHeadlights();
                if (e.code === 'KeyH') audioEngine.playHorn();
                if (e.code === 'KeyR' && gameState.screen === 'RACING') resetPlayerOnTrack();
                if (e.code === 'KeyE' && playerVehicle && gameSettings.transmission === 'MANUAL') {
                    const g = typeof playerVehicle.gear === 'number' ? playerVehicle.gear : 1;
                    if (g < playerVehicle.spec.gears) { playerVehicle.gear = g + 1; audioEngine.playGearShift('UP'); }
                }
                if (e.code === 'KeyQ' && playerVehicle && gameSettings.transmission === 'MANUAL') {
                    const g = typeof playerVehicle.gear === 'number' ? playerVehicle.gear : 1;
                    if (g > 1) { playerVehicle.gear = g - 1; audioEngine.playGearShift('DOWN'); }
                }
                if (e.code === 'Escape') {
                    if (settingsModal.classList.contains('open')) closeSettings();
                    else if (gameState.screen === 'RACING') openSettings();
                }
            }
        });

        window.addEventListener('keyup', (e) => {
            if (e.code === 'ArrowUp' || e.code === 'KeyW') controls.throttle = 0;
            if (e.code === 'ArrowDown' || e.code === 'KeyS') controls.brake = 0;
            if (e.code === 'ArrowLeft' || e.code === 'KeyA') controls.steerLeft = false;
            if (e.code === 'ArrowRight' || e.code === 'KeyD') controls.steerRight = false;
            if (e.code === 'Space') controls.handbrake = false;
            if (e.code === 'ShiftLeft' || e.code === 'ShiftRight') controls.nos = false;
        });

        window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
            camera.aspect = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;
            camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
            renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
        });

        /* ============================================================================
           12. MAIN SIMULATION LOOP & INITIALIZATION
           ============================================================================ */
        let lastFrameTime = performance.now();

        function animateLoop(now) {
            requestAnimationFrame(animateLoop);
            const dt = Math.min(0.05, (now - lastFrameTime) / 1000);
            lastFrameTime = now;

            // Animate Cheering Grandstand Fans
            if (crowdAnimators.length > 0 && gameState.screen !== 'MENU') {
                const tSec = now * 0.001;
                for (let i = 0; i < crowdAnimators.length; i += 2) {
                    const fan = crowdAnimators[i];
                    fan.mesh.position.y = fan.baseY + Math.abs(Math.sin(tSec * fan.speed + fan.phase)) * 0.35;
                }
            }

            // Update Rain / Snow Weather Particles & Thunderstorm Lightning
            if (weatherParticles.visible && playerVehicle) {
                const posArr = weatherGeo.attributes.position.array;
                const fallSpeed = gameSettings.weather === 'SNOW' ? 14 : 68;
                for (let i = 0; i < WEATHER_PARTICLE_COUNT; i++) {
                    posArr[i * 3 + 1] -= fallSpeed * dt;
                    if (posArr[i * 3 + 1] < 0) {
                        posArr[i * 3] = playerVehicle.pos.x + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 240;
                        posArr[i * 3 + 1] = 75 + Math.random() * 20;
                        posArr[i * 3 + 2] = playerVehicle.pos.z + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 240;
                    }
                }
                weatherGeo.attributes.position.needsUpdate = true;

                if (gameSettings.weather === 'STORM') {
                    gameState.lightningTimer -= dt;
                    if (gameState.lightningTimer <= 0) {
                        gameState.lightningTimer = 4 + Math.random() * 8;
                        const flash = document.getElementById('lightning-flash');
                        flash.style.opacity = '0.75';
                        setTimeout(() => { flash.style.opacity = '0'; }, 90);
                        audioEngine.playThunder();
                    }
                }
            }

            if (gameState.screen === 'COUNTDOWN') {
                const prevSec = Math.ceil(gameState.countdownTimer);
                gameState.countdownTimer -= dt;
                const currSec = Math.ceil(gameState.countdownTimer);

                const banner = document.getElementById('countdown-banner');
                if (currSec > 0 && currSec !== prevSec) {
                    banner.textContent = String(currSec);
                    banner.style.color = '#ffffff';
                    audioEngine.playBeep(440, 0.18);
                }

                updatePlayerPhysics(dt, true);
                updateAiVehicles(dt, true);
                updateCamera(dt);
                updateHudDisplay();

                if (gameState.countdownTimer <= 0) {
                    gameState.screen = 'RACING';
                    gameState.goBannerTimer = 1.4;
                    banner.textContent = 'GO!';
                    banner.style.color = '#30d158';
                    banner.style.textShadow = '0 0 36px rgba(48, 209, 88, 0.9), 0 4px 14px rgba(0,0,0,0.85)';
                    audioEngine.playBeep(880, 0.35);
                }
            } else if (gameState.screen === 'RACING') {
                gameState.raceTime += dt;

                if (gameState.goBannerTimer > 0) {
                    gameState.goBannerTimer -= dt;
                    if (gameState.goBannerTimer <= 0) {
                        const banner = document.getElementById('countdown-banner');
                        banner.style.display = 'none';
                        banner.style.textShadow = '0 0 30px var(--primary-glow), 0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.8)';
                    }
                }

                updatePlayerPhysics(dt, false);
                updateAiVehicles(dt, false);
                updateCamera(dt);
                updateHudDisplay();
            } else {
                updateCamera(dt);
            }

            renderer.render(scene, camera);
        }

        window.onload = function () {
            renderCarList('ALL');
            updateCarSpecsPanel();
            renderTrackList();
            renderPaintAndUpgrades();
            rebuildShowcaseCar();
            trackWorldGroup.visible = false;
            showcaseGroup.visible = true;
            scene.background = new THREE.Color(0x0b101d);
            scene.fog = new THREE.FogExp2(0x0b101d, 0.015);
            animateLoop(performance.now());
        };
    })();
    </script>
</body>
</html>
